items.title: 古爾斯比力挺華許抗通膨！警告經濟過熱 通膨尚未脫離險境
items.title_en: Goolsbee Backs Warsh’s Anti‑Inflation Stance, Warns Economy Is Overheating and Inflation Still in Danger
paras: 芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)周五(28日)表示，他認同聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)主張應把抗通膨列為首要任務的看法。
古爾斯比受訪說：「我同意主席提出的分析，我們的通膨率一直高於目標，而且此前走勢朝錯誤方向發展。雖然近幾個月的數據較為溫和，但這絕對不代表我們已經脫離險境。
華許周五在懷俄明州傑克森霍爾的全球央行年會演說時表示，儘管今年夏季公布的個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE) 與消費者物價指數 (CPI) 優於預期，但這些數據仍不足以證明潛在通膨趨勢已出現有意義的改善。
華許強調，Fed 必須確信潛在通膨正「明確且以足夠速度」朝 2% 目標前進，否則 Fed 仍「有工作要做。」他還提到，目前金融環境並不具有限制性，利率仍是 Fed 實現政策使命的「主要工具」。
雖然華許並未直接表態支持9月升息，但市場將這番談話解讀為明顯偏鷹。芝商所(CME)FedWatch 顯示，交易員押注Fed 9月升息1碼的機率，在演說後突破五成，遠高於前一日的約 35%。短債殖利率在演說後迅速跳升，2年期美債殖利率大漲約12個基點至4.35%。
目前美國通膨依然居高不下，與Fed 2%目標相比甚至比一年前更遙遠。經濟過熱的跡象隨處可見——勞動市場罕見呈現招募與裁員活動都維持低檔，美國經濟雖持續成長，但主要動能來自人工智慧(AI)以及資料中心建設。
古爾斯比補充指出，Fed官員目前正面臨一個問題：近期通膨升高的趨勢究竟只是暫時現象，還是會因經濟過熱而演變成更頑強的通膨。他擔心的是，Fed決策官員對於該如何讓經濟降溫，仍存在高度不確定性。他表示，下一波衝擊可能隨時就在眼前。
paras_en: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said on Friday the 28th that he agrees with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s view that fighting inflation should be the top priority.

In the interview Goolsbee said, “I agree with the Chair’s analysis – our inflation rate has been above target and the trend has been moving in the wrong direction. Although the data in recent months have been more moderate, that certainly does not mean we are out of danger.”

Warsh told the Global Central Bank Conference in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, that even though this summer’s personal consumption expenditures price index (PCE) and consumer price index (CPI) came in better than expected, the numbers are still insufficient to show a meaningful improvement in underlying inflation trends.

Warsh stressed that the Fed must be convinced that underlying inflation is moving “clearly and at a sufficient pace” toward the 2% goal, otherwise the Fed still “has work to do.” He also noted that the current financial environment is not restrictive and that interest rates remain the Fed’s “primary tool” for achieving its policy mission.

Although Warsh did not explicitly endorse a September rate hike, markets read his remarks as clearly hawkish. CME FedWatch showed that after the speech traders’ odds of a one‑point hike in September jumped above 50%, up from roughly 35% the day before. Short‑term Treasury yields surged, with the two‑year yield climbing about 12 basis points to 4.35% after the remarks.

U.S. inflation remains high, even farther from the Fed’s 2% target than a year ago. Signs of an overheating economy are everywhere – the labor market is unusually tight with both hiring and layoffs at low levels, and while the U.S. economy continues to grow, its main drivers are AI and data‑center construction.

Goolsbee added that Fed officials now face a key question: whether the recent uptick in inflation is a temporary blip or a sign that overheating will turn into more stubborn inflation. He warned that policymakers are still highly uncertain about how to cool the economy and said the next shock could be right around the corner.

items.title: 美海軍被曝陷入嚴重財政危機！傳靠挪用軍人「薪水」打伊朗
paras: 美國對伊朗的軍事行動持續延燒，軍費壓力也逐步浮現。《衛報》報導指出，美國海軍因承擔對伊朗軍事行動及海上封鎖任務，現有預算面臨嚴重壓力，甚至被迫調度原本用於支付軍人薪資的資金。
報導指出，美國總統川普自2月28日發動對伊朗軍事行動後，美軍預算壓力明顯升高，其中海軍除了參與最初幾輪攻擊，後續也負責執行海上封鎖。
一份美國國防部有關海軍經費的備忘錄顯示，國防部為支應軍事行動，調用了原本配置在薪資帳戶中的資金，導致資金短缺。
一名知情軍官表示，軍方目前只能透過不同帳戶之間調度資金來填補缺口，甚至出現原本準備支付薪資的款項遭挪用，再以其他尚未動用的資金補回的情況。
美國海軍2026財政年度預算接近3000億美元，但受到法律規範限制，無法自由重新分配各項預算。
川普政府本財政年度提出670億美元的緊急追加撥款申請，其中約150億美元預計用於採購「愛國者」飛彈、「薩德」反導系統及多款飛彈，但相關申請並未說明其中有多少資金將投入海軍。
美國眾議院7月已通過總額1.15兆美元的2027財政年度國防授權法案，另有730億美元專門作為伊朗戰事相關額外支出。
不過，《衛報》認為，由於美國國內對伊朗戰事普遍缺乏支持，這兩項預算案能否獲得參議院批准仍存在疑問。
對於外界關注軍費是否已經見底，美國海軍發言人在聲明中表示，目前維持及作戰經費「尚未耗盡」，海軍部正積極調配資源，以確保能夠按時履行現有薪資支付義務。
然而，報導指出，海軍內部的資金吃緊早已不是秘密。隨著戰事持續，如何為一場沒有明確終點的軍事行動取得足夠資金，已成為更大的問題。在資金壓力下，美國海軍部分岸上設施的非緊急維護工作已經暫停。
一名前海軍軍官、目前擔任海軍承包商的知情人士更形容，美軍不僅消耗大量軍事彈藥，也已面臨資金耗盡的困境。

伊朗海上封鎖持續　美軍投入逾20艘軍艦

美軍對伊朗的海上封鎖自7月中旬恢復後，伊朗從本國港口出口的石油降至零，未獲美方許可的船隻也無法進出伊朗港口，目前僅因人道主義理由的船隻獲准通行。
美國中央司令部司令庫珀（Brad Cooper）上將8月27日表示，自封鎖恢復以來，美軍已投入超過20艘軍艦及數百架軍機，迫使75艘企圖突破封鎖的船隻掉頭，另有3艘拒絕服從指令的船隻被迫失去行動能力。目前約有5萬名美軍人員在中東執行相關任務。
與此同時，美軍航母部署也面臨壓力。近日「華盛頓號」（USS George Washington）才接替已在海上部署超過200天的「林肯號」（USS Abraham Lincoln），但美軍很快又計畫派遣「羅斯福號」（USS Theodore Roosevelt）接替「華盛頓號」。
中國現代國際關係研究院中東所副所長秦天分析，美軍希望維持在中東地區的軍事壓力，因此持續調派航母。但隨著「華盛頓號」抵達中東，美軍在亞太地區出現多年罕見的「零航母」狀態，反映美軍在中東乃至全球兵力部署上面臨的困境。
針對近期美軍航母接連傳出長時間部署及艦上人員心理危機等消息，秦天指出，美軍此次與伊朗的戰事高度依賴航母，原因之一在於伊朗曾以飛彈及無人機攻擊美軍部署在海灣地區的前線基地，使這些基地難以充分分擔作戰任務，也無法完全為航母提供安全靠泊與補給服務。

白宮稱美伊目前沒有談判　川普：不急著讓伊朗回談判桌

外交層面上，美伊目前也未出現新的談判進展。白宮新聞秘書萊維特（Karoline Leavitt）27日表示，美國與伊朗目前「沒有進行任何談判」，這種情況將持續到川普認為伊朗可能以有意義的方式重返談判桌為止。
萊維特表示，美國仍將透過各種經濟手段持續對伊朗施壓，川普「仍保留所有選項」，而他的首要目標是確保伊朗永遠無法取得核武器。
川普26日接受卡達半島電視台訪問時則表示，他對伊朗何時重返談判桌「沒有時間表」，也不急於推動談判。他稱美國正在取得重大勝利，並指出伊朗正面臨嚴重通膨與經濟崩潰；當被問及經濟制裁是否比軍事打擊更有效時，川普回答兩者都有效。
不過，伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚（Masoud Pezeshkian）同日透過伊朗學生通訊社表示，伊朗政府已採取相關措施，因此美國目前的經濟施壓不會取得成果，就如同美方在戰事中同樣未能達成目標。

items.title: 「巴菲特式投資」可能淪為AI時代受害者？
items.title_en: Will Buffett‑Style Investing Become a Victim of the AI Era?
paras: 「巴菲特式投資」可能成為 AI 時代的受害者。科技分析師兼播客主持人 Dwarkesh Patel 警告，當全球資本加速流向 AI 基礎設施，依靠長期穩定現金流支撐估值的波克夏·海瑟威式股票，恐面臨大幅重新定價。
Patel 所指的「巴菲特式股票」，是投資人願意長期持有、預期未來數十年持續創造良好現金流的企業。然而，隨著 OpenAI、Anthropic 等前沿 AI 實驗室快速擴充運算能力，資金正大量湧向資料中心、半導體、能源和機器人等領域，傳統企業的吸引力可能隨之下降。
這波投資潮也將讓微軟 (MSFT-US)、Alphabet (GOOG-US)、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 和 Meta (META-US) 等超大規模雲端業者吸收更多資本。Patel 認為，當 AI 基礎設施展現更高的潛在報酬，投資人將要求傳統企業提供更高收益，才願意繼續投入資金。
真正威脅巴菲特式股票的關鍵，在於折現率上升。利率及投資人要求的報酬率一旦走高，企業未來現金流換算成當前價值後便會下降，導致原本以穩定獲利為賣點的企業估值受到壓縮。
Patel 直言，市場可能因此形成兩極化走勢。AI 類股大漲或許足以支撐整體指數，但幾乎所有其他股票都可能下跌，尤其是那些以未來 30 年穩定現金流作為估值基礎的「巴菲特、波克夏類型股票」。
這種資本轉移的衝擊也可能擴散至債券市場。Patel 警告，資金成本急升可能形成類似「第二次伏克爾衝擊」的局面，增加開發中國家爆發主權債務違約的風險。
他舉例，若美國投資級超大規模雲端業者的債券可以提供約 10%報酬，投資人便不願再以僅約 5%的利率借錢給埃及等風險較高的國家。這將迫使財政脆弱的國家及傳統產業支付更高的融資成本，否則可能面臨違約。
Patel 認為，AI 快速成長長期而言可能創造更富足的經濟，但在資本全面轉向新科技的過渡期，巴菲特所偏好的穩定現金流資產，反而可能因資金機會成本飆升而承受沉重賣壓。
paras_en: Buffett‑style investing may become a victim of the AI era. Technology analyst and podcast host Dwarkesh Patel warns that as global capital accelerates toward AI infrastructure, stocks that rely on long‑term stable cash flows to support valuation—like Berkshire Hathaway‑style equities—may face significant re‑pricing.

Patel’s “Buffett‑style stocks” are companies investors are willing to hold long term, expecting to generate strong cash flows for decades. However, as cutting‑edge AI labs such as OpenAI and Anthropic rapidly expand computing power, capital is pouring into data centers, semiconductors, energy and robotics, potentially eroding the appeal of traditional firms.

This investment wave will also allow mega‑cloud players such as Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOG‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Meta (META‑US) to absorb more capital. Patel believes that when AI infrastructure shows higher potential returns, investors will demand higher yields from traditional companies before they are willing to keep investing.

The real threat to Buffett‑style stocks lies in rising discount rates. When interest rates and required returns climb, the present value of a company’s future cash flows falls, compressing the valuation of firms that previously sold themselves on stable profitability.

Patel bluntly states that the market may polarize. AI‑related stocks could surge enough to support the overall index, while almost all other stocks—especially those that base valuation on 30‑year stable cash flows—might decline.

The capital shift could also spill over into the bond market. Patel warns that a sharp rise in funding costs could create a situation akin to a “second Volcker shock,” increasing the risk of sovereign debt defaults in developing countries.

He gives an example: if U.S. investment‑grade mega‑cloud issuers can offer about 10% returns, investors will no longer lend at roughly 5% to higher‑risk countries like Egypt. This would force fiscally fragile nations and traditional industries to pay higher financing costs or face default.

Patel believes that while AI’s rapid growth may create a richer economy in the long run, during the transition when capital fully shifts to new technology, the stable‑cash‑flow assets favored by Buffett may suffer heavy selling pressure as the opportunity cost of capital soars.

items.title: 伊朗戰爭只是小衝擊！ 哈佛教授羅格夫預言更大衝突恐引爆美債危機 政策工具所剩無幾
paras: 哈佛大學經濟學家羅格夫(Kenneth Rogoff)警告，美國民眾恐怕得遭遇一場「衝擊」，才會開始要求政府改變債務相關經濟政策。現在的伊朗戰爭只能算是「小型衝擊」，一旦爆發更大危機，聯準會(Fed)與美國政府能夠採取的政策空間將相當有限。
他預測未來五年可能出現的衝擊，包括網路戰、人工智慧(AI)帶來的顛覆，以及「最有可能」發生的台海衝突，都可能推動利率大幅走高。
曾任國際貨幣基金(IMF)首席經濟學家的羅格夫，周五(28日)在美國懷俄明州傑克遜霍爾全球央行年會受訪時指出，美國債務多年來毫無節制地累積，原因在於學術界經濟學家抱持「近乎宗教般」的信念，認為利率將會無止境下滑。
不過羅格夫指出，即使利率已從低點反彈並持續攀升，政治領袖仍未做出調整，「利率已經反轉，但華盛頓卻沒有」。
美國國債總額上周突破40兆美元，引發警訊，甚至讓一些過去主張寬鬆財政政策的「赤字鴿派」人士也開始感到擔憂。
利率攀升也推高政府利息支出，例如30年期美國公債標售殖利率創2001年以來最高水準。隨著債務惡化、投資人要求更高殖利率，可能形成一種「死亡螺旋」(doom loop)。此外，華盛頓普遍認為，選民將反對透過加稅或大幅削減支出來縮小財政赤字。
羅格夫表示，目前30年期長債所反映的環境顯示，一旦危機爆發，Fed與美國政府能夠採取的政策空間將相當有限。
他預測未來五年可能出現的衝擊，包括網路戰、人工智慧(AI)帶來的顛覆，以及「最有可能」發生的台海衝突，都可能推動利率大幅走高。
羅格夫說，「危機發生在衝擊出現、而你卻沒有韌性的時候」，並形容伊朗戰爭與未來五年可能發生的情況相比，只能算是「小型衝擊」。
對於社會安全制度改革，羅格夫同樣直言不諱。他表示，要讓政府對社會福利等權利型支出計畫採取有意義的改革行動，恐怕也需要一場危機來催化改變，因為選民目前仍未真正相信問題有多麼迫切。
羅格夫在著作《Our Dollar, Your Problem》中預測，在改革取得政治可行性之前，美國「最終將以某種形式的危機收場」。他並表示，如果2028年有候選人以改革社會安全制度為政見參選，恐怕會發現「人們聽到後就開始神遊」。

items.title: 伊朗總統：若荷姆茲海峽重開「美國必須履行其義務」、軍方強調「船隻未經協調不得通過」
items.title_en: Iranian President: If the Strait of Hormuz Reopens, the U.S. Must Fulfill Its Obligations; Military Emphasizes Ships Cannot Pass Without Coordination
paras: 伊朗與美國圍繞荷姆茲海峽通行問題的立場仍存明顯落差。伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚（Masoud Pezeshkian）週五（28日）表示，伊朗與阿曼近期就荷姆茲海峽重新開放航道達成共識，但若要推動重開，美國也必須履行相關承諾。與此同時，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊海軍則強調，目前對這條戰略水道的控制權仍然穩固，未經伊朗協調的船隻不得通行。
根據中國《央視》報導，佩澤希齊揚表示，阿曼最初支持伊朗的立場，之後態度一度有所保留，但雙方近期重新會面後，再度取得共識，同意在協調一致的計畫下重新開放荷姆茲海峽航道。
不過，伊朗並未將航道重開視為單方面的決定。佩澤希齊揚指出，伊朗目前正設法確保，一旦在特定框架下恢復通行，美國也必須同步履行應盡義務。
根據他的說法，相關要求包括解除封鎖與制裁、解凍伊朗資金，以及停止以色列在黎巴嫩的敵對行動。
此外，伊朗將依據自身政策決定荷姆茲海峽的開放方式；他並表示，海峽重開符合《伊斯蘭堡諒解備忘錄》所規定的框架，且已獲各方接受，因此應當落實執行。
就在伊朗總統釋出談判訊息之際，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊海軍則對外界所稱荷姆茲海峽已開放的說法提出反駁。
革命衛隊海軍28日發表聲明，指控美國官員宣稱荷姆茲海峽開放是「謊言」，目的在於操控油價並掩蓋美方的失敗。
革命衛隊強調，目前對這條戰略水道的控制權「絕對穩固」，並已下令所有未經伊朗協調、試圖通過荷姆茲海峽的船隻不得通行。
革命衛隊海軍進一步表示，相關限制將持續至美國停止對伊朗的軍事行動，並履行其應盡義務為止。
paras_en: Iran and the United States still have a clear gap in their positions on the passage of the Strait of Hormuz. President Masoud Pezeshkian on Friday (28th) said that Iran and Oman recently reached a consensus to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, but for the reopening to proceed, the United States must also fulfill its related commitments. At the same time, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy emphasized that control over this strategic waterway remains solid and that ships cannot pass without Iranian coordination.

According to a report by China’s CCTV, Pezeshkian said Oman initially supported Iran’s position, then became somewhat reserved, but after recent meetings the two sides again reached a consensus and agreed to reopen the Strait of Hormuz under a coordinated plan.

However, Iran does not view the reopening as a unilateral decision. Pezeshkian pointed out that Iran is currently working to ensure that once passage is restored under a specific framework, the United States must also simultaneously fulfill its obligations.
According to him, the relevant requirements include lifting blockades and sanctions, unfreezing Iranian funds, and stopping Israel’s hostile actions in Lebanon.

In addition, Iran will determine the manner of reopening the Strait of Hormuz based on its own policy; he said the reopening aligns with the framework set out in the Islamic City Memorandum of Understanding and has been accepted by all parties, so it should be implemented.
Just as the Iranian president released negotiation messages, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy rebutted claims that the Strait of Hormuz had opened.
The IRGC Navy issued a statement on the 28th, accusing U.S. officials of calling the opening a "lie" aimed at manipulating oil prices and covering up U.S. failures.

The IRGC emphasized that control over this strategic waterway is "absolutely solid" and has ordered that all ships attempting to pass the Strait of Hormuz without Iranian coordination must not be allowed to pass.
The IRGC Navy further stated that the restrictions will continue until the United States stops its military actions against Iran and fulfills its obligations.

items.title: 戴爾財報後股價料波動10% 市場預期上看506美元
items.title_en: Dell Shares Expected to Volatile 10% After Earnings, Market Anticipates $506
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，戴爾科技(Dell Technologies)(DELL-US)預計將於下周二收盤後公布最新一季財報，這家電腦與伺服器製造商的股價目前接近近期高點。
目前選擇權價格顯示，交易員預期戴爾股價在公布財報後，到下周結束前可能出現上下10%的波動。以周五(28日)午盤約460美元股價計算，若出現這樣幅度的波動，股價最高可能升至506美元，接近本月稍早創下的514美元歷史新高。若向下波動，則可能跌至413美元，回吐今年以來部分漲幅。
戴爾股價今年以來已飆升約260%，成為今年標普500指數中漲幅最大股票之一，主要受AI資料中心對其伺服器需求日益增加的推動。
今年5月，戴爾公布季度業績優於預期並上調全年財測，帶動股價單日大漲超過30%。
戴爾此次財報公布前，AI交易已經歷一段劇烈波動期，市場對硬體支出能否持續的疑慮，令投資人對這項領域的信心受到動搖。
摩根士丹利分析師在財報公布前指出，戴爾及其他硬體製造商目前面臨較高的市場預期。由於股價近幾個月大幅上漲，華爾街正期待戴爾大幅上調全年獲利預測。
分析師預期戴爾第二季營收將達451.9億美元，年增超過50%。根據Visible Alpha彙整的預估數據，調整後每股獲利預計為4.91美元，超過去年同期的兩倍。
華爾街分析師普遍看好戴爾，Visible Alpha追蹤的6位分析師中，有5位給予「買進」評級、1位給予中立評級。他們的平均目標價為505美元，意味著較近期股價約有10%上漲空間。
戴爾股價周五收盤下跌3.2%，至每股456.24美元。
paras_en: Investopedia reports that Dell Technologies (DELL-US) is expected to release its latest quarterly earnings after the market close next Tuesday, and the computer and server maker’s stock is currently near a recent high.

Current option pricing indicates that traders anticipate Dell’s stock could swing up or down 10% after the earnings release, by the end of next week. Using Friday’s (28th) midday price of about $460, a 10% swing could lift the stock to a high of $506, close to the $514 all‑time high set earlier this month. A downside swing could bring it down to $413, erasing part of the gains seen this year.
Dell’s stock has surged about 260% this year, making it one of the biggest gainers in the S&P 500, largely driven by growing demand for its servers from AI data centers.
In May, Dell announced quarterly results that beat expectations and raised its full‑year outlook, sparking a single‑day jump of over 30% in the stock price.

Before this earnings release, AI trading had already experienced a period of sharp volatility, and concerns about whether hardware spending would continue have shaken investors’ confidence in the sector.

Morgan Stanley analysts noted before the earnings that Dell and other hardware makers are currently facing high market expectations. With the stock having risen sharply in recent months, Wall Street is looking for a significant upward revision of Dell’s full‑year earnings forecast.

Analysts expect Dell’s Q2 revenue to reach $45.19 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of more than 50%. According to estimates compiled by Visible Alpha, the adjusted earnings per share are projected at $4.91, more than double the same period last year.

Wall Street analysts are generally bullish on Dell. Of the six analysts tracked by Visible Alpha, five gave a “buy” rating and one gave a neutral rating. Their average target price is $505, implying about a 10% upside from the recent price.
Dell’s stock fell 3.2% on Friday’s close to $456.24 per share.

items.title: 高油價引爆美國消費K型分化！小資族更依賴「1美元商店」就近採買、高所得族照買非必需品
items.title_en: Rising Oil Prices Spark Consumer Segmentation in the U.S. – Low‑Income Shoppers Rely More on Dollar Stores, High‑Income Families Continue Buying Non‑Essentials
paras: 美國消費市場正出現日益明顯的兩極分化。Dollar General(DG-US)與Dollar Tree(DLTR-US)最新財報顯示，對價格敏感的消費者愈來愈依賴「1美元商店」折扣商，尤其汽油價格上漲後，消費者減少長途購物、轉向住家附近採買，進一步推升折扣店客流。高收入家庭也持續光顧這類商店，購買非必需品。
兩家公司周四公布的上季營收都超越市場預期。其中，Dollar General上修全年銷售預測，並表示將在今年下半年恢復庫藏股計畫，帶動周四(27日)股價一度大漲約8%，終場仍漲2.5%。
Dollar General是全美最大1美元商店，擁有2.1萬家門市。該公司正在提高一般商品在商品組合中的占比，以因應收入較低消費者尋找更便宜的服飾、居家用品與玩具的趨勢。
Dollar General高層表示，汽油價格上漲迫使消費者減少出門購物的次數，並改在住家附近採買，有助於提升客流量。
Jefferies分析師Corey Tarlowe表示：「在汽油價格偏高的環境下，我們認為Dollar General是消費者愈來愈依賴的零售業態。」
同行Dollar Tree則出現四季以來首見的平均客流量增加。該公司目前正走出出售Family Dollar事業後的轉型期，加上對本季的獲利預估不如市場預期，周四終場下跌3.9%
值得注意的是，Dollar General與Dollar Tree高層均表示，燃料價格將在今年下半年拖累利潤率。
這兩家1美元折扣零售商的財報，凸顯美國經濟分化日益擴大：收入較低消費者轉向價格更實惠的商品，並延後非必要消費，而高收入家庭仍大手筆購買非必需品。
美國零售業指標企業沃爾瑪(WMT-US)上周罕見公布單季銷售不及市場預期，凸顯消費支出疲弱。另一方面，美國總統川普警告，隨著伊朗戰爭持續，燃料價格可能維持高檔。
Dollar Tree執行長Todd Vasos周四在分析師電話會議上表示：「最值得注意的是，燃料價格上漲且波動加劇，迫使消費者進一步將採購重點放在物有所值與價格實惠上。」
1美元商店如今也加入從沃爾瑪到目標百貨(Target)等零售商的行列，把部分關稅退款投入降價，針對食品雜貨及一般商品數千種商品調降價格，以藉此刺激消費。
Vasos表示，Dollar Tree在最近一季把收到的關稅退款中相當大一部分重新投入業務，以強化價格優勢，包括針對暑期假日推出促銷活動，以及降低日常商品價格。
paras_en: The U.S. consumer market is increasingly polarized. Dollar General (DG-US) and Dollar Tree (DLTR-US) latest earnings show that price‑sensitive shoppers are turning more to $1 discount stores, especially after gasoline prices rose, leading consumers to cut long trips and shop closer to home, further boosting foot traffic at discount retailers. High‑income households also continue to visit these stores to buy non‑essential items.

Both companies announced Q4 revenue that beat market expectations on Thursday. Dollar General raised its full‑year sales forecast and said it would resume its share‑repurchase program in the second half of the year, sending its stock up about 8% intraday before closing 2.5% higher.

Dollar General is the largest $1 store in the U.S., with 21,000 locations. The company is increasing the share of general merchandise in its assortment to meet the trend of lower‑income consumers seeking cheaper clothing, household goods, and toys.
Dollar General executives said that higher gasoline prices are forcing consumers to shop less frequently and to buy closer to home, which helps increase foot traffic.
Jefferies analyst Corey Tarlowe said, "In an environment of high gasoline prices, we believe Dollar General is a retail format that consumers are increasingly relying on."

Dollar Tree, a peer, saw its first seasonal increase in average foot traffic in four years. The company is emerging from the transition after selling its Family Dollar business, and with earnings guidance below expectations, its stock fell 3.9% on Thursday.
It is worth noting that executives at both Dollar General and Dollar Tree said fuel prices will drag on profit margins in the second half of the year.

The earnings of these two $1 discount retailers highlight the widening economic divide in the U.S.: lower‑income consumers turn to more affordable goods and postpone non‑essential spending, while high‑income households continue to make large purchases of non‑essentials.

Last week, retail indicator Walmart (WMT-US) unusually reported quarterly sales that fell short of expectations, underscoring weak consumer spending. Meanwhile, former President Trump warned that as the war in Iran continues, fuel prices may remain high.

Dollar Tree CEO Todd Vasos said on Thursday during an analyst call, "The most noteworthy thing is that fuel prices are rising and volatility is increasing, forcing consumers to focus even more on value and affordability."

$1 stores are now joining the ranks of retailers from Walmart to Target, allocating some of their tariff refunds to price cuts, reducing prices on thousands of grocery and general merchandise items to stimulate consumption.

Vasos said Dollar Tree recently reinvested a substantial portion of its tariff refunds back into the business to strengthen its price advantage, including promotional activities for the summer holidays and lowering everyday product prices.

items.title: 華許首秀過關！債市投下Fed主席最想要的信任票
items.title_en: Warsh’s First Test Passes! Bond Market Casts the Trust Vote Fed Chair Wants Most
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會釋出偏鷹訊號後，美國短期公債殖利率大幅上升，長期殖利率卻大致持穩。這種市場反應對新任央行主席而言，比債券上漲更重要，因為它代表投資人相信華許有意採取行動控制通膨。
華許週五表示，近期通膨仍令人擔憂，聯準會必須確認物價正明確且以足夠速度回到2%目標，否則還有工作要做。他也指出，除房市與農業等部分領域外，整體金融環境很難被形容為具有限制性，顯示目前利率尚未明顯壓抑經濟活動。
這番談話迅速改變市場定價。芝商所 FedWatch 工具顯示，交易員預估聯準會9月升息的機率，由本週稍早略高於30%升至接近60%。
根據FactSet數據，美國2年期公債殖利率週五上升12個基點至4.352%，創五週新高；30年期公債殖利率則大致持平於5.207%。兩者利差縮小至約87個基點，為近一個月最低。
殖利率曲線趨平反映出兩層市場預期：短期利率可能維持高檔甚至進一步上升，但較緊縮的政策最終可望抑制物價，因此長期通膨風險並未同步惡化。
Clocktower Group首席總體策略師Eric Wallerstein表示，經歷數次讓市場難以判讀新主席立場的聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 會議後，交易員需要看到聯準會對控制通膨的承諾。華許此次演說初步回應了這項需求。
長債賣壓並非主要來自通膨
不過，債市接受華許的抗通膨訊號，不代表近期美債面臨的所有壓力都已解除。長天期公債殖利率升至20年高點附近，主要受到財政與供給因素推動，而非單純反映物價前景。
美國政府債務已突破40兆美元，財政赤字約1.8兆美元，財政部因而必須發行數兆美元新債。科技業超大規模雲端業者也在大量發行長期公司債，為AI資料中心建設籌措資金，與美國政府競爭市場資本。
Wallerstein指出，長期借貸成本仍取決於經濟表現、財政前景及科技巨頭後續發債規模，這些因素多半不在聯準會控制範圍內。
9月升息仍要看數據
XTB研究主管Kathleen Brooks提醒，單次偏鷹演說不足以確立未來利率路徑。華許不支持透過前瞻指引預告政策，因此市場仍須依據後續經濟數據調整預期。
若下週公布的勞動市場報告再次疲弱，9月升息機率可能迅速下降，週五出現的短債賣壓也可能隨之消退。
縮表方向成為下一項考驗
華許此次並未說明如何處理規模約6.7兆至6.8兆美元的聯準會資產負債表。他正主導縮減央行資產規模的檢討，但任何進一步量化緊縮，都可能增加市場需要承接的美債供給。
Fidelis Capital固定收益主管Chris Gunster認為，這項政策與財政部降低長期利率的努力存在潛在矛盾。財長貝森特正透過債券回購計畫降低借貸成本；若聯準會同步減少美債持有部位，可能反而對長債殖利率形成上行壓力。
因此，華許這次通過的是「市場是否相信其抗通膨決心」的考驗；接下來，他還須面對經濟數據變化，以及如何在縮減資產負債表的同時，避免加重長債市場壓力。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh issued a hawkish signal at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Summit, U.S. short‑term Treasury yields surged while long‑term yields largely held steady. This market reaction is more important for the new chair than bond price moves, as it signals investors believe Warsh intends to act to control inflation.

Warsh said on Friday that inflation remains concerning and the Fed must confirm that prices are clearly and quickly returning to the 2% target, otherwise more work is needed. He also noted that, aside from housing and agriculture, the overall financial environment is difficult to describe as restrictive, indicating current rates have not yet noticeably stifled economic activity.
This speech quickly altered market pricing. The CME FedWatch tool shows traders’ probability of a September rate hike rose from just over 30% earlier this week to nearly 60%.

According to FactSet data, the U.S. 2‑year Treasury yield rose 12 basis points to 4.352% on Friday, a five‑week high; the 30‑year yield remained roughly flat at 5.207%. The spread narrowed to about 87 basis points, the lowest in nearly a month.

The flattening yield curve reflects two layers of market expectations: short‑term rates may stay high or rise further, but tighter policy is expected to curb inflation, so long‑term inflation risk has not worsened in tandem.

Eric Wallerstein, chief overall strategist at Clocktower Group, said that after several FOMC meetings that left markets uncertain about the new chair’s stance, traders needed to see the Fed’s commitment to controlling inflation. Warsh’s speech initially met that need.
Long‑bond selling pressure is not primarily driven by inflation

However, the bond market’s acceptance of Warsh’s anti‑inflation signal does not mean all recent pressures on U.S. Treasuries have been lifted. Long‑term Treasury yields have risen to near 20‑year highs, driven mainly by fiscal and supply factors rather than purely reflecting price outlooks.

U.S. government debt has surpassed $40 trillion, with a fiscal deficit of about $1.8 trillion, forcing the Treasury to issue several trillion dollars in new debt. Large cloud‑service tech firms are also issuing long‑term corporate bonds in bulk to fund AI data‑center construction, competing with the government for market capital.
Wallerstein noted that long‑term borrowing costs still depend on economic performance, fiscal outlook, and the scale of future tech‑giant bond issuances—factors largely outside the Fed’s control.
September rate hike still depends on data

Kathleen Brooks, head of research at XTB, warned that a single hawkish speech is insufficient to set the future rate path. Warsh does not support forward guidance, so markets must still adjust expectations based on subsequent economic data.
If the labor‑market report released next week remains weak, the probability of a September hike could drop sharply, and the short‑bond selling pressure seen on Friday might fade.
The direction of the balance‑sheet reduction becomes the next test

Warsh did not explain how he would handle the Fed’s balance sheet, which stands at about $6.7 to $6.8 trillion. He is leading a review of reducing the central bank’s asset size, but any further quantitative tightening could increase the supply of Treasuries the market must absorb.

Chris Gunster, fixed‑income head at Fidelis Capital, believes this policy may conflict with Treasury efforts to lower long‑term rates. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen is reducing borrowing costs through a bond‑repurchase program; if the Fed simultaneously cuts Treasury holdings, it could actually push long‑bond yields higher.

Thus, Warsh’s test this time is whether the market believes in his anti‑inflation resolve; next, he must face changing economic data and how to trim the balance sheet without adding pressure to the long‑bond market.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉精材今明年營運旺 三大法人同步敲進周漲26%
items.title_en: <Hot Stock> Jingcai Anticipates Strong Operations in 2024-2025, All Three Major Institutional Investors Buy, Stock Up 26% This Week
paras: 精材(3374-TW)受惠測試業務、8吋與12吋新專案逐步導入量產，今、明兩年營運動能強勁，加上台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)與日本感測晶片索尼合資，精材被外界視為是主要受惠對象之一，本周吸引三大法人全數敲進，單周股價大漲25.94%，收在386元，創下一個月來高點。
精材下半年隨著與合作夥伴的測試業務持續放大，以及8吋新專案逐步進入量產，下半年整體營運可望優於上半年。精材測試業務目前占全年營收達6成，新廠無塵室上季底已擴建完畢，測試機台也將在本月底全數進機，成為今、明兩年營運主要動能。
此外，台積電與索尼於日本合資建廠，外界看好，台積電集團旗下精材與采鈺(6789-TW)都著墨於CMOS影像感測器多年，未來若索尼進一步擴大外包，精材與采鈺都可望同步沾光，搶進AI視覺領域。
精材本周於周二落底後一路向上，周五更亮燈漲停，達386元，單周成交量達8.7萬張，三大法人也全站買方，外資狂敲8,694張、投信加碼3,335張、自營商也買超1,105張，三大法人合計買進1.3萬張。
paras_en: Jingcai (3374-TW) benefits from testing services and the gradual ramp‑up of new 8‑inch and 12‑inch projects into mass production, giving it strong operational momentum for this year and next. In addition, TSMC (2330-TW) (TSM-US) and Japan’s sensor chip maker Sony have formed a joint venture, and Jingcai is seen as a primary beneficiary. This week all three major institutional investors bought in, pushing the stock up 25.94% to NT$386, a one‑month high.

In the second half of the year, as testing services with partners continue to expand and the new 8‑inch project moves into mass production, Jingcai’s overall performance is expected to outpace the first half. Testing services now account for about 60% of annual revenue. The clean‑room of the new plant was completed at the end of last quarter, and testing equipment will be fully installed by the end of this month, becoming the main driver for operations in 2024‑2025.

Furthermore, TSMC and Sony’s joint venture plant in Japan has drawn positive sentiment. Both Jingcai, a TSMC group subsidiary, and Caiyu (6789-TW) have been involved in CMOS image sensors for years. If Sony further expands its outsourcing, both companies could share the benefits and advance into the AI‑vision market.

Jingcai’s stock fell to a low on Tuesday but rallied steadily, hitting the daily limit up on Friday at NT$386. Weekly volume reached 87,000 shares. All three major institutional investors were net buyers: foreign investors purchased 8,694 shares, investment trusts added 3,335 shares, and proprietary traders bought a net 1,105 shares, totaling about 13,000 shares bought by the three groups.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉松川精密獲AI需求助攻外資也力挺 股價收新天價327.5元
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Songchuan Precision Gains AI Demand Boost, Foreign Investors Also Support, Stock Closes at New High of 327.5 TWD
paras: AI 需求強勁，繼電器廠松川精密 (7788-TW) 在涵蓋數據中心變頻器、伺服器電源與 UPS，高電壓大電流產品從 2025 下半年起開始明顯放量，同時，推升松川在營收高速成長並連創新高，股價 28日收漲停327.5元創新天價，周漲 31.79%。外資本周買超1340張。
同時，松川的營收已經連續三季改寫歷史新高，由統計數據顯示，就數據中心變頻器、伺服器電源與不斷電系統（UPS）的高電壓大電流產品出貨金額來看，在 2026 年 上半年營收占比成長到 17%，換算出貨金額達 7 億元，並較 2025 年同期的 3.88 億元大幅成長 80%，業績成長狀況並將延續。
繼電器廠松川精密在今年第一季及第二季營收都改寫新高，7月營收也爲歷史新高，第三季業績將再衝一波，股價 28日收在漲停的327.5 元，周線拉出長紅棒，周漲31.79%，並站上所有均線，技術線型偏多，短線支撐在 5 日線 282.1元。
paras_en: Strong AI demand has led relay manufacturer Songchuan Precision (7788-TW) to see a clear increase in shipments of high‑voltage, high‑current products for data‑center inverters, server power supplies, and UPS units starting in the second half of 2025. This has driven Songchuan's revenue to grow rapidly and set new records, with the stock closing at the daily limit of 327.5 TWD on the 28th, a new all‑time high, up 31.79% for the week. Foreign investors bought a net 1,340 lots this week.

Songchuan's revenue has set new historical highs for three consecutive quarters. According to the data, the shipment value of high‑voltage, high‑current products for data‑center inverters, server power supplies, and UPS systems will account for 17% of revenue in the first half of 2026, amounting to NT$700 million, which is an 80% increase over the NT$388 million recorded in the same period of 2025, and the growth trend is expected to continue.

Relay maker Songchuan Precision posted record revenues in both the first and second quarters of this year, and July revenue also reached a historic high. The third‑quarter performance is expected to surge again. The stock closed at the daily limit of 327.5 TWD on the 28th, producing a long bullish candlestick for the week, up 31.79%, and it is now above all moving averages, indicating a bullish technical pattern, with short‑term support at the 5‑day moving average of 282.1 TWD.

items.title: 新創迎黃金期！產創條例修正3大亮點吸睛 4大會計為何搶按讚？一表看
items.title_en: Startups Enter Golden Era! Three Key Highlights of the Revised Industrial Innovation Act Capture Attention, Why Four Accounting Firms Are Rushing to Like? One Table Shows It All
paras: 立法院27 日三讀通過《產業創新條例》（下稱產創條例）部分條文修正案。本次修法重點在於提高員工獎酬股票緩課額度、放寬新創事業設立年限認定，以及調降有限合夥創投穿透課稅的投資門檻。此舉不僅大幅強化企業留才攬才的誘因，更活絡了新創事業的長期資金挹注，獲得國內資誠、勤業眾信和安候建業三大會計師事務所專家一致肯定。

亮點一：員工獎酬股票緩課翻倍至1000萬 明年元旦上路

為了因應近年台灣經濟成長與整體薪酬水準的顯著提升，本次修法將產創條例第 19 條之 1 的員工獎酬股票緩課額度上限，自新台幣 500 萬元倍增至 1,000 萬元，並自 116 年 1 月 1 日起正式適用。
資誠聯合會計師事務所稅務法律服務會計師林巨峯表示，符合條件的員工獎酬股票在額度內可適用緩課機制，金額增加一倍，將能有效降低員工因取得股票而立即面臨的大額稅負壓力，大幅強化企業運用股權作為留才工具的能力。安侯建業聯合會計師事務所稅務部執業會計師黃彥賓也指出，此次修法參考了與台灣產業型態接近的國家作法，切合台灣產業留住關鍵人才的需求，將能有效預防優秀人才外流國外。
林巨峯特別提醒，115 年 12 月 31 日前取得的員工獎酬股票，仍僅能適用 500 萬元的舊上限。建議在今年底前有計畫發放獎酬股票的公司，或許能重新思考並調整股票的發放時程至明年，讓員工能充分享受到 1,000 萬元的租稅優惠。

亮點二：創投投資門檻調降 告別為了節稅而「倉促投資」

針對產創條例第 23 條之 1 有限合夥創投事業的租稅優惠，本次修法大幅降低了第 3 至第 5 年度累計投資新創之比例門檻（修正至實收出資總額的 10%、20%、30%），並新增第 6 年度達 40% 的規範，給予創投更合理的投資評估期。此外，對於「在台實際營運外國公司」的認定，也放寬至在台設立直接或間接控制之子公司或分公司者皆適用。
安侯建業聯合會計師事務所稅務部執業會計師黃彥賓分析，創投成立初期多處於募資與投資評估階段。調降投資門檻能提供創投更充裕的布局空間，避免過去為了符合租稅優惠門檻，而在時限內「倉促投資」的窘境，這將有助於創投做出更高質量的投資決策。

亮點三：新創事業認定放寬至8年 契合研發成長週期

在天使投資人租稅優惠（第 23 條之 2）以及創投租稅優惠中，本次修法將適用之新創事業設立年限由現行的「未滿 5 年」放寬至「未滿 8 年」（自公布生效日起適用），使其能與經濟部《具創新能力之新創事業認定原則》接軌。
勤業眾信聯合會計師事務所稅務部會計師劉紋廷指出，這項修法更貼近創新企業實際的研發與成長週期，能有效助攻新創事業獲得更穩定的長期資金。劉紋廷建議，隨著相關適用條件與優惠範圍的調整，企業與投資人應及早檢視現行的投資架構、獎酬員工股份制度並評估租稅優惠申請，以充分掌握本次修法帶來的政策紅利，為產業創新發展注入更多成長動能。
產創條例修正前後對照表
paras_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the Industrial Innovation Act (hereafter referred to as the Industrial Innovation Act) amendments in its third reading on the 27th. The amendments focus on increasing the deferred tax limit for employee incentive shares, relaxing the establishment period criteria for startups, and lowering the investment threshold for limited partnership venture capital to reduce pass‑through taxation. These changes significantly strengthen incentives for companies to retain and attract talent, stimulate long‑term funding for startups, and have received unanimous praise from the three major accounting firms PwC, EY, and KPMG.

Highlight One: Employee incentive share deferral limit doubled to NT$10 million, effective from New Year's Day next year. To respond to Taiwan’s recent economic growth and rising overall wage levels, the amendment raises the cap in Article 19 (1) of the Industrial Innovation Act from NT$5 million to NT$10 million, effective from January 1, 2027.

PwC’s tax and legal services partner Lin Jufeng noted that eligible employee incentive shares within the new limit can use the deferral mechanism, doubling the amount and effectively reducing the immediate tax burden on employees who receive shares, thereby greatly enhancing companies’ ability to use equity as a retention tool. EY’s tax partner Huang Yabin added that the amendment draws on practices from countries with similar industrial profiles, aligning with Taiwan’s need to retain key talent and preventing the outflow of top talent abroad.

Lin Jufeng specifically warned that shares acquired before December 31, 2026, will still be subject to the old NT$5 million limit. He suggested that companies planning to grant incentive shares this year consider adjusting the timing to next year so employees can fully benefit from the NT$10 million tax advantage.

Highlight Two: Lowered venture capital investment threshold to end rushed tax‑saving investments. The amendment significantly reduces the cumulative investment proportion thresholds for limited partnership venture capital in Articles 23 (1) (3)–(5) to 10%, 20%, and 30% of the total paid‑in capital, and introduces a 40% threshold for the sixth year, providing a more reasonable investment evaluation period. It also relaxes the definition of a “foreign company operating in Taiwan” to include those with direct or indirect subsidiaries or branches in Taiwan.

EY’s tax partner Huang Yabin explained that early-stage venture capital firms often face fundraising and investment assessment stages. Lowering the investment threshold gives VCs more room to deploy capital, avoiding the past dilemma of hurried investments to meet tax‑benefit thresholds, thereby enabling higher‑quality investment decisions.

Highlight Three: Startup establishment period extended to 8 years to match R&D growth cycles. The amendment expands the eligibility period for angel investors and venture capital tax incentives from the current “less than 5 years” to “less than 8 years,” effective from the date of promulgation, aligning with the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ principles for recognizing innovative startups.

EY’s tax partner Liu Wenting noted that this amendment better reflects the actual R&D and growth cycles of innovative enterprises, effectively helping startups secure more stable long‑term funding. He advised that, with the adjusted eligibility conditions and incentive scope, companies and investors should review their current investment structures, employee share incentive plans, and tax‑benefit applications early to fully capture the policy dividends of the amendment and inject more growth momentum into industrial innovation.

items.title: 輝達財報+MSCI雙利多！台股兆元成交量再現 法人本周掃貨10檔ETF名單一次看
items.title_en: NVIDIA Earnings + MSCI Dual Boost! Taiwan Stock Market Sees Record Volume, Institutional Investors Sweep 10 ETFs in One Week
paras: MSCI 三大指數同步調升台股權重，下周一(8/31)盤後生效，加上輝達財報超標效應持續顯現，台股市場情緒大受激勵，不僅三大法人站在買方，本周以來合計買超台股988億元，大盤成交量能也連續 4 天放大，本周最後一個交易日成交金額站回兆元大關，顯示法人散戶合力看多台股，資金同步歸隊，有望再次點燃台股資金行情。
盤點近一周三大法人買賣超，ETF 買超萬張以上的有 20 檔，買超3萬張以上的有10檔，包含5檔主動式、2檔正2、2檔高股息，以及1檔海外主題型，其中又以主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)、群益台灣加權正2(00685L-TW)、元大台灣50正2(00631L-TW)，以及主動凱基台灣(00407A-TW)最受法人青睞，本周獲三大法人合力買超5萬張以上，並列本周法人最愛F4。
除了法人回補外，這10檔法人掃貨ETF的散戶人氣也同步升溫，財經專家觀察，這10檔中近7日成交量最高4檔，合計成交量皆達百萬張以上，同樣為兩檔台股主動式與2檔台股正2，顯示台股有企業實質獲利支撐成長動能，籌碼沉澱過後人氣回籠，不論法人或散戶資金，皆積極透過主動式與槓桿式ETF伺機布局台股反彈行情。
主動凱基台灣ETF研究團隊表示，儘管CSP業者的自由現金流承受壓力，資本支出規模卻持續上修，台股評價雖目前偏高，但「賣鏟子」的台灣廠商成長動能來自實際訂單、出貨與營收表現，企業獲利仍處於上修階段，只要獲利成長的速度追得上股價，偏高的評價有望被逐步消化。
實務操作面上，主動凱基台灣 ETF 研究團隊建議，可以把「年線」視為中期趨勢的分水嶺，當指數站穩年線之上，回檔即是分批布局AI核心供應鏈的機會；配置上，優先布局訂單能見度高、具技術門檻、能將規格升級轉化為毛利率與現金流的族群。

paras_en: MSCI’s three major indices simultaneously increased Taiwan’s weighting, effective after market close on Monday (8/31). Coupled with NVIDIA’s earnings surpassing expectations, the market sentiment was strongly stimulated. Not only did the three major institutions stand on the buying side, but they have cumulatively bought 98.8 billion NTD of Taiwan stocks this week. The market’s trading volume has expanded for four consecutive days, and the total transaction value on the last trading day of the week returned to the trillion‑NTD level, indicating that institutional and retail investors are jointly bullish on Taiwan stocks and that capital is returning to the market, potentially reigniting a funding rally.

In the past week, 20 ETFs saw net purchases of over 10,000 shares, and 10 ETFs saw net purchases of over 30,000 shares, including 5 actively managed, 2 “正2” (positive 2), 2 high‑dividend, and 1 overseas‑theme ETF. Among them, the actively managed Uni‑Taiwan 50 (00403A‑TW), Yuanta Taiwan 50 Positive 2 (00631L‑TW), and KGI Taiwan (00407A‑TW) were most favored by institutions, with a combined net purchase of over 50,000 shares this week, ranking them as the institutions’ favorite F4.

Beyond institutional replenishment, the 10 ETFs that institutions swept also saw a rise in retail popularity. Analysts observed that among these, the top four by volume in the past seven days each traded over a million shares, including two actively managed and two positive‑2 ETFs. This indicates that Taiwan stocks have solid earnings‑driven growth momentum; after the concentration of holdings, popularity has rebounded. Whether institutional or retail capital, both are actively using active and leveraged ETFs to position for a rebound.

The KGI Taiwan ETF research team noted that although CSP operators face pressure on free cash flow, capital expenditures are still being revised upward. Taiwan’s valuations are currently high, but the growth momentum of “sell‑shovel” Taiwanese manufacturers comes from actual orders, shipments, and revenue performance. Company profits remain in an upward revision phase; as long as profit growth keeps pace with stock price, the high valuation may gradually be absorbed.

From a practical standpoint, the KGI Taiwan ETF research team suggests treating the “annual line” as a watershed for medium‑term trends. When the index stands firmly above the annual line, a pullback is an opportunity to gradually allocate to AI core supply chains. In terms of allocation, prioritize sectors with high order visibility, technical barriers, and the ability to translate specification upgrades into margin and cash flow.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉精確AI液冷散熱業務將起飛 周反彈18%至近1個半月高
items.title_en: Precise AI Liquid Cooling Business Set to Take Off as Shares Rally 18% to Near 1½-Month High
paras: 精確(3162-TW)宣布取得國際散熱解決方案大廠 Cooler Master(訊凱國際)Vendor Code，正式成為其合格供應商，亦即旗下AI液冷散熱業務取得初步成功，激勵本周股價反彈18%，回升至近1個半月來相對高。
精確指出，此次獲國際一線散熱廠商認證，可謂成功切入全球散熱供應鏈，隨新一代GPU算力提升、伺服器整機功耗持續增長，液冷散熱已成高階AI伺服器主流散熱方案，相關零組件的需求正持續擴張。
未來精確與Cooler Master合作從前期產品開發、樣品驗證階段，邁入正式供應商合作體系，期待下一代AI伺服器平台帶來的市場增量機會。
法人分析，精確在電動車電池盒的生產及成本管理達到一定程度的經濟規模，未來1-2年營收看增可達20%，另一方面，水冷零組件在策略投資人加入後將有更明確的產能規劃，可帶動產品組合轉佳，此外，人型機器人帶來潛在的想像成長空間。
paras_en: Precise (3162‑TW) announced it has obtained the vendor code from international cooling solutions giant Cooler Master (Synnex International), officially becoming a qualified supplier and marking a first success for its AI liquid cooling business, which has spurred an 18% rebound in the stock price this week to a relative high not seen in nearly a month and a half.

Precise noted that being certified by a top-tier global cooling manufacturer represents a successful entry into the worldwide cooling supply chain; with the next‑generation GPU compute power increasing and server total power consumption continuing to rise, liquid cooling has become the mainstream solution for high‑end AI servers, and demand for related components is expanding steadily.

In the future, Precise will move from early product development and sample verification with Cooler Master into a formal supplier partnership, looking forward to the market growth opportunities brought by next‑generation AI server platforms.

Corporate analysts say Precise has achieved a certain scale in production and cost management of electric vehicle battery packs, with revenue expected to grow 20% in the next one to two years; meanwhile, water‑cooling components will have clearer capacity planning after strategic investors join, potentially improving the product mix, and humanoid robots offer additional growth potential.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉麗臺擁抱AI解決方案下半年營運看俏 外資力挺本周強漲逾一成
items.title_en: Hot Stock: LITE-TECH Embraces AI Solutions, Strong Weekly Rise Over 10% Supported by Foreign Investors
paras: 顯卡與伺服器解決方案廠麗臺(2465-TW)本周在轉型為AI解決方案供應商效益顯現下，持續吸引買盤進駐，28日收95元，周漲逾一成，周成交量20161張，其中外資連三買，共買超877張。
麗臺近年全力加速策略轉型，由過去以繪圖處理器代理銷售為主，轉型為多元化實體AI與地端AI解決方案商，聚焦推出工作站、伺服器及系統軟體應用，主攻重視資訊安全的企業與政府單位。
麗臺今年正式成立新事業處，並策略結盟合計持股約三成的大股東大訊科技與肯微，引進機殼設計、水冷與液冷等技術優勢，共同拓展系統端與完整AI解決方案銷售。
展望後市，目前AI市場需求大於供給，隨著輝達獨家代理產品線放量出貨、漲價效應發揮，加上高單價系統產品貢獻度放大，法人看好在零組件供應無虞下，下半年接單動能強勁且營運可望持續走升。
paras_en: LITE-TECH (2465-TW), a graphics card and server solutions provider, has continued to attract buying interest as its transformation into an AI solutions supplier shows benefits, closing at NT$95 on the 28th with a weekly gain of over 10%, trading 20,161 shares, with foreign investors making three consecutive purchases and buying a total of 877 shares.

LITE-TECH has recently accelerated its strategic transformation, moving from a focus on selling graphics processor agents to becoming a diversified physical AI and edge AI solutions provider, concentrating on launching workstations, servers, and system software applications, targeting enterprises and government units that prioritize information security.

This year, LITE-TECH officially established a new business division and strategically aligned with major shareholders Daxun Technology and Kenwei, who together hold about 30% of the shares, bringing in advantages in chassis design, water cooling, and liquid cooling technologies to jointly expand system-level and complete AI solutions sales.

Looking ahead, the AI market demand currently exceeds supply; with NVIDIA’s exclusive product line ramping up shipments and price increases taking effect, coupled with the growing contribution of high-priced system products, institutional investors are optimistic that, with no supply constraints on components, the second half of the year will see strong order momentum and continued upward operating performance.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉緯穎9/2除權相當於「買一送二」 飆創7245元新天價
items.title_en: Popular Stock: Wei Ying’s 9/2 Ex‑Dividend Is Like a "Buy One Get Two" Deal, Skyrocketing to a New All‑Time High of 7,245 TWD
paras: 緯穎(6669-TW)AI伺服器展望正向，法人看好，在AWS Trainium3出貨增溫帶動下，營收可望季增雙位數，同時，緯穎將於下周三(2日)除權交易，吸引資金湧入，激勵緯穎本周漲逾1成，並衝上7245元創歷史新天價。
緯穎本周漲15.11%，周五(28日)最高漲至7245元，突破7000元，並創下歷史新天價，終場收7200元，位居千金股第3名，僅次於信驊(5274-TW)及川湖(2059-TW)，站穩所有均線。不過三大法人本周著墨不多，本周合計賣超125張。
法人指出，除AWS Trainium3將挹注緯穎第三季營運，由於水冷機櫃主要出貨時間點將落在明年，因此看好緯穎明年營收更上一層樓，有望年增近1倍，獲利也可望攀升，明年EPS有機會挑戰60個股本。
緯穎2026年配發2025年現金股利約144.39元，已於6月22日除息完畢。在股票股利方面，原先規劃每股配發19.8422578元股票股利，每仟股配發1984.22578股，總計配發37.17億元股票股利。後調整為每股配發19.8279460元，每仟股配發1982.79460股，相當於1張緯穎股票可配發約1.983張股票。
緯穎指出，由於公司2024年第1次海外無擔保可轉換公司債債權人申請轉換普通股，致影響流通在外股數總額，董事長依8月7日董事會授權調整股票股利配股率。

items.title: 古爾斯比力挺華許抗通膨！警告經濟過熱 通膨尚未脫離險境
items.title_en: Goolsbee Backs Warsh’s Anti‑Inflation Stance, Warns Economy Is Overheating and Inflation Still in Danger
paras: 芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)周五(28日)表示，他認同聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)主張應把抗通膨列為首要任務的看法。
古爾斯比受訪說：「我同意主席提出的分析，我們的通膨率一直高於目標，而且此前走勢朝錯誤方向發展。雖然近幾個月的數據較為溫和，但這絕對不代表我們已經脫離險境。
華許周五在懷俄明州傑克森霍爾的全球央行年會演說時表示，儘管今年夏季公布的個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE) 與消費者物價指數 (CPI) 優於預期，但這些數據仍不足以證明潛在通膨趨勢已出現有意義的改善。
華許強調，Fed 必須確信潛在通膨正「明確且以足夠速度」朝 2% 目標前進，否則 Fed 仍「有工作要做。」他還提到，目前金融環境並不具有限制性，利率仍是 Fed 實現政策使命的「主要工具」。
雖然華許並未直接表態支持9月升息，但市場將這番談話解讀為明顯偏鷹。芝商所(CME)FedWatch 顯示，交易員押注Fed 9月升息1碼的機率，在演說後突破五成，遠高於前一日的約 35%。短債殖利率在演說後迅速跳升，2年期美債殖利率大漲約12個基點至4.35%。
目前美國通膨依然居高不下，與Fed 2%目標相比甚至比一年前更遙遠。經濟過熱的跡象隨處可見——勞動市場罕見呈現招募與裁員活動都維持低檔，美國經濟雖持續成長，但主要動能來自人工智慧(AI)以及資料中心建設。
古爾斯比補充指出，Fed官員目前正面臨一個問題：近期通膨升高的趨勢究竟只是暫時現象，還是會因經濟過熱而演變成更頑強的通膨。他擔心的是，Fed決策官員對於該如何讓經濟降溫，仍存在高度不確定性。他表示，下一波衝擊可能隨時就在眼前。
paras_en: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said on Friday the 28th that he agrees with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s view that fighting inflation should be the top priority.

In the interview Goolsbee said, “I agree with the Chair’s analysis – our inflation rate has been above target and the trend has been moving in the wrong direction. Although the data in recent months have been more moderate, that certainly does not mean we are out of danger.”

Warsh told the Global Central Bank Conference in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, that even though this summer’s personal consumption expenditures price index (PCE) and consumer price index (CPI) came in better than expected, the numbers are still insufficient to show a meaningful improvement in underlying inflation trends.

Warsh stressed that the Fed must be convinced that underlying inflation is moving “clearly and at a sufficient pace” toward the 2% goal, otherwise the Fed still “has work to do.” He also noted that the current financial environment is not restrictive and that interest rates remain the Fed’s “primary tool” for achieving its policy mission.

Although Warsh did not explicitly endorse a September rate hike, markets read his remarks as clearly hawkish. CME FedWatch showed that after the speech traders’ odds of a one‑point hike in September jumped above 50%, up from roughly 35% the day before. Short‑term Treasury yields surged, with the two‑year yield climbing about 12 basis points to 4.35% after the remarks.

U.S. inflation remains high, even farther from the Fed’s 2% target than a year ago. Signs of an overheating economy are everywhere – the labor market is unusually tight with both hiring and layoffs at low levels, and while the U.S. economy continues to grow, its main drivers are AI and data‑center construction.

Goolsbee added that Fed officials now face a key question: whether the recent uptick in inflation is a temporary blip or a sign that overheating will turn into more stubborn inflation. He warned that policymakers are still highly uncertain about how to cool the economy and said the next shock could be right around the corner.

items.title: 「巴菲特式投資」可能淪為AI時代受害者？
items.title_en: Will Buffett‑Style Investing Become a Victim of the AI Era?
paras: 「巴菲特式投資」可能成為 AI 時代的受害者。科技分析師兼播客主持人 Dwarkesh Patel 警告，當全球資本加速流向 AI 基礎設施，依靠長期穩定現金流支撐估值的波克夏·海瑟威式股票，恐面臨大幅重新定價。
Patel 所指的「巴菲特式股票」，是投資人願意長期持有、預期未來數十年持續創造良好現金流的企業。然而，隨著 OpenAI、Anthropic 等前沿 AI 實驗室快速擴充運算能力，資金正大量湧向資料中心、半導體、能源和機器人等領域，傳統企業的吸引力可能隨之下降。
這波投資潮也將讓微軟 (MSFT-US)、Alphabet (GOOG-US)、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 和 Meta (META-US) 等超大規模雲端業者吸收更多資本。Patel 認為，當 AI 基礎設施展現更高的潛在報酬，投資人將要求傳統企業提供更高收益，才願意繼續投入資金。
真正威脅巴菲特式股票的關鍵，在於折現率上升。利率及投資人要求的報酬率一旦走高，企業未來現金流換算成當前價值後便會下降，導致原本以穩定獲利為賣點的企業估值受到壓縮。
Patel 直言，市場可能因此形成兩極化走勢。AI 類股大漲或許足以支撐整體指數，但幾乎所有其他股票都可能下跌，尤其是那些以未來 30 年穩定現金流作為估值基礎的「巴菲特、波克夏類型股票」。
這種資本轉移的衝擊也可能擴散至債券市場。Patel 警告，資金成本急升可能形成類似「第二次伏克爾衝擊」的局面，增加開發中國家爆發主權債務違約的風險。
他舉例，若美國投資級超大規模雲端業者的債券可以提供約 10%報酬，投資人便不願再以僅約 5%的利率借錢給埃及等風險較高的國家。這將迫使財政脆弱的國家及傳統產業支付更高的融資成本，否則可能面臨違約。
Patel 認為，AI 快速成長長期而言可能創造更富足的經濟，但在資本全面轉向新科技的過渡期，巴菲特所偏好的穩定現金流資產，反而可能因資金機會成本飆升而承受沉重賣壓。
paras_en: Buffett‑style investing may become a victim of the AI era. Technology analyst and podcast host Dwarkesh Patel warns that as global capital accelerates toward AI infrastructure, stocks that rely on long‑term stable cash flows to support valuation—like Berkshire Hathaway‑style equities—may face significant re‑pricing.

Patel’s “Buffett‑style stocks” are companies investors are willing to hold long term, expecting to generate strong cash flows for decades. However, as cutting‑edge AI labs such as OpenAI and Anthropic rapidly expand computing power, capital is pouring into data centers, semiconductors, energy and robotics, potentially eroding the appeal of traditional firms.

This investment wave will also allow mega‑cloud players such as Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOG‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Meta (META‑US) to absorb more capital. Patel believes that when AI infrastructure shows higher potential returns, investors will demand higher yields from traditional companies before they are willing to keep investing.

The real threat to Buffett‑style stocks lies in rising discount rates. When interest rates and required returns climb, the present value of a company’s future cash flows falls, compressing the valuation of firms that previously sold themselves on stable profitability.

Patel bluntly states that the market may polarize. AI‑related stocks could surge enough to support the overall index, while almost all other stocks—especially those that base valuation on 30‑year stable cash flows—might decline.

The capital shift could also spill over into the bond market. Patel warns that a sharp rise in funding costs could create a situation akin to a “second Volcker shock,” increasing the risk of sovereign debt defaults in developing countries.

He gives an example: if U.S. investment‑grade mega‑cloud issuers can offer about 10% returns, investors will no longer lend at roughly 5% to higher‑risk countries like Egypt. This would force fiscally fragile nations and traditional industries to pay higher financing costs or face default.

Patel believes that while AI’s rapid growth may create a richer economy in the long run, during the transition when capital fully shifts to new technology, the stable‑cash‑flow assets favored by Buffett may suffer heavy selling pressure as the opportunity cost of capital soars.

items.title: 伊朗戰爭只是小衝擊！ 哈佛教授羅格夫預言更大衝突恐引爆美債危機 政策工具所剩無幾
paras: 哈佛大學經濟學家羅格夫(Kenneth Rogoff)警告，美國民眾恐怕得遭遇一場「衝擊」，才會開始要求政府改變債務相關經濟政策。現在的伊朗戰爭只能算是「小型衝擊」，一旦爆發更大危機，聯準會(Fed)與美國政府能夠採取的政策空間將相當有限。
他預測未來五年可能出現的衝擊，包括網路戰、人工智慧(AI)帶來的顛覆，以及「最有可能」發生的台海衝突，都可能推動利率大幅走高。
曾任國際貨幣基金(IMF)首席經濟學家的羅格夫，周五(28日)在美國懷俄明州傑克遜霍爾全球央行年會受訪時指出，美國債務多年來毫無節制地累積，原因在於學術界經濟學家抱持「近乎宗教般」的信念，認為利率將會無止境下滑。
不過羅格夫指出，即使利率已從低點反彈並持續攀升，政治領袖仍未做出調整，「利率已經反轉，但華盛頓卻沒有」。
美國國債總額上周突破40兆美元，引發警訊，甚至讓一些過去主張寬鬆財政政策的「赤字鴿派」人士也開始感到擔憂。
利率攀升也推高政府利息支出，例如30年期美國公債標售殖利率創2001年以來最高水準。隨著債務惡化、投資人要求更高殖利率，可能形成一種「死亡螺旋」(doom loop)。此外，華盛頓普遍認為，選民將反對透過加稅或大幅削減支出來縮小財政赤字。
羅格夫表示，目前30年期長債所反映的環境顯示，一旦危機爆發，Fed與美國政府能夠採取的政策空間將相當有限。
他預測未來五年可能出現的衝擊，包括網路戰、人工智慧(AI)帶來的顛覆，以及「最有可能」發生的台海衝突，都可能推動利率大幅走高。
羅格夫說，「危機發生在衝擊出現、而你卻沒有韌性的時候」，並形容伊朗戰爭與未來五年可能發生的情況相比，只能算是「小型衝擊」。
對於社會安全制度改革，羅格夫同樣直言不諱。他表示，要讓政府對社會福利等權利型支出計畫採取有意義的改革行動，恐怕也需要一場危機來催化改變，因為選民目前仍未真正相信問題有多麼迫切。
羅格夫在著作《Our Dollar, Your Problem》中預測，在改革取得政治可行性之前，美國「最終將以某種形式的危機收場」。他並表示，如果2028年有候選人以改革社會安全制度為政見參選，恐怕會發現「人們聽到後就開始神遊」。

items.title_en: Warsh Reaffirms Anti-Inflation Stance, US Stocks Close Lower, Nvidia Slides 4.6%
paras: 2026年08月29日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國聯準會主席Kevin Warsh在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會重申2%通膨目標，表示若無法確認通膨正以足夠速度回落，聯準會仍有「更多工作要做」，市場因此提高9月升息預期，美股三大指數週五同步收低。
標普500指數下跌0.25%至7,711.76點，那斯達克指數下跌0.52%至26,402.42點，道瓊工業指數小跌0.02%至53,559.99點。不過，全週仍維持上漲，標普500、那斯達克與道瓊分別上漲0.49%、0.85%及0.53%。

Warsh堅守2%通膨目標市場重新評估9月升息
Warsh表示，近期通膨數據尚未顯示趨勢已經改變，若通膨無法明確朝2%目標回落，貨幣政策仍需進一步因應。交易員因此增加9月升息押注，目前市場對升息或維持利率不變的預期大致各半。
美國銀行美國經濟研究主管Aditya Bhave認為，除非8月就業與通膨數據明顯疲弱，Warsh在此次偏鷹談話後，9月是否採取升息行動將成為市場檢視聯準會政策可信度的焦點。

AI晶片股降溫輝達跌4.6%、Marvell重挫10.3%
科技股則從前一交易日財報行情回落。輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)下跌4.6%；Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)重挫10.3%，儘管公司上調2027會計年度營收預測，市場仍擔心與Google合作的客製化AI晶片訂單要到較晚時間才能明顯貢獻營收。
大型科技股表現相對有撐，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)上漲1.7%，帶動標普500通訊服務類股；蘋果Apple(AAPL-US)上漲1.6%。Salesforce(CRM-US)延續財報後漲勢，再漲1.6%。
個股方面，PayPal(PYPL-US)重挫12.7%，市場傳出Advent與Stripe組成的財團已放棄收購計畫；Gap(GAP-US)則大漲近13%，公司更換Old Navy執行長並上調全年獲利展望。

paras_en: On August 29, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated the 2% inflation target at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank meeting, saying that if inflation cannot be confirmed to be falling at a sufficient pace, the Fed still has “more work to do.” Markets therefore raised expectations of a September rate hike, and the three major US indices all closed lower on Friday.

The S&P 500 fell 0.25% to 7,711.76 points, the Nasdaq slipped 0.52% to 26,402.42 points, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average edged down 0.02% to 53,559.99 points. However, the week as a whole remained positive, with the S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow up 0.49%, 0.85% and 0.53% respectively.

Warsh stuck to the 2% inflation goal, prompting the market to reassess a September hike. He said recent inflation data have not shown a changed trend, and if inflation does not clearly move toward the 2% target, monetary policy will need further adjustment. Traders therefore increased bets on a September hike, and the market’s expectations for a hike versus holding rates steady are now roughly split.

Bank of America US Economic Research head Aditya Bhave noted that unless August employment and inflation data are markedly weak, the focus will shift to whether a September rate hike occurs after Warsh’s relatively hawkish remarks, becoming a test of the Fed’s policy credibility.

AI chip stocks cooled, with Nvidia (NVDA-US) down 4.6% and Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) plunging 10.3%. Despite Marvell raising its fiscal 2027 revenue forecast, the market remains concerned that custom AI chip orders with Google will not contribute significantly to revenue until later.

Large‑cap tech stocks held up better: Alphabet (GOOGL-US) rose 1.7%, lifting the S&P 500 communications‑services sector; Apple (AAPL-US) gained 1.6%; and Salesforce (CRM-US) continued its post‑earnings rally with another 1.6% increase.

On the individual stock front, PayPal (PYPL-US) tumbled 12.7% amid reports that the Advent‑Stripe consortium has abandoned its acquisition plan, while Gap (GAP-US) surged nearly 13% after appointing a new CEO for Old Navy and raising its full‑year profit outlook.

items.title: 戴爾財報後股價料波動10% 市場預期上看506美元
items.title_en: Dell Shares Expected to Volatile 10% After Earnings, Market Anticipates $506
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，戴爾科技(Dell Technologies)(DELL-US)預計將於下周二收盤後公布最新一季財報，這家電腦與伺服器製造商的股價目前接近近期高點。
目前選擇權價格顯示，交易員預期戴爾股價在公布財報後，到下周結束前可能出現上下10%的波動。以周五(28日)午盤約460美元股價計算，若出現這樣幅度的波動，股價最高可能升至506美元，接近本月稍早創下的514美元歷史新高。若向下波動，則可能跌至413美元，回吐今年以來部分漲幅。
戴爾股價今年以來已飆升約260%，成為今年標普500指數中漲幅最大股票之一，主要受AI資料中心對其伺服器需求日益增加的推動。
今年5月，戴爾公布季度業績優於預期並上調全年財測，帶動股價單日大漲超過30%。
戴爾此次財報公布前，AI交易已經歷一段劇烈波動期，市場對硬體支出能否持續的疑慮，令投資人對這項領域的信心受到動搖。
摩根士丹利分析師在財報公布前指出，戴爾及其他硬體製造商目前面臨較高的市場預期。由於股價近幾個月大幅上漲，華爾街正期待戴爾大幅上調全年獲利預測。
分析師預期戴爾第二季營收將達451.9億美元，年增超過50%。根據Visible Alpha彙整的預估數據，調整後每股獲利預計為4.91美元，超過去年同期的兩倍。
華爾街分析師普遍看好戴爾，Visible Alpha追蹤的6位分析師中，有5位給予「買進」評級、1位給予中立評級。他們的平均目標價為505美元，意味著較近期股價約有10%上漲空間。
戴爾股價周五收盤下跌3.2%，至每股456.24美元。
paras_en: Investopedia reports that Dell Technologies (DELL-US) is expected to release its latest quarterly earnings after the market close next Tuesday, and the computer and server maker’s stock is currently near a recent high.

Current option pricing indicates that traders anticipate Dell’s stock could swing up or down 10% after the earnings release, by the end of next week. Using Friday’s (28th) midday price of about $460, a 10% swing could lift the stock to a high of $506, close to the $514 all‑time high set earlier this month. A downside swing could bring it down to $413, erasing part of the gains seen this year.
Dell’s stock has surged about 260% this year, making it one of the biggest gainers in the S&P 500, largely driven by growing demand for its servers from AI data centers.
In May, Dell announced quarterly results that beat expectations and raised its full‑year outlook, sparking a single‑day jump of over 30% in the stock price.

Before this earnings release, AI trading had already experienced a period of sharp volatility, and concerns about whether hardware spending would continue have shaken investors’ confidence in the sector.

Morgan Stanley analysts noted before the earnings that Dell and other hardware makers are currently facing high market expectations. With the stock having risen sharply in recent months, Wall Street is looking for a significant upward revision of Dell’s full‑year earnings forecast.

Analysts expect Dell’s Q2 revenue to reach $45.19 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of more than 50%. According to estimates compiled by Visible Alpha, the adjusted earnings per share are projected at $4.91, more than double the same period last year.

Wall Street analysts are generally bullish on Dell. Of the six analysts tracked by Visible Alpha, five gave a “buy” rating and one gave a neutral rating. Their average target price is $505, implying about a 10% upside from the recent price.
Dell’s stock fell 3.2% on Friday’s close to $456.24 per share.

items.title: 高油價引爆美國消費K型分化！小資族更依賴「1美元商店」就近採買、高所得族照買非必需品
items.title_en: Rising Oil Prices Spark Consumer Segmentation in the U.S. – Low‑Income Shoppers Rely More on Dollar Stores, High‑Income Families Continue Buying Non‑Essentials
paras: 美國消費市場正出現日益明顯的兩極分化。Dollar General(DG-US)與Dollar Tree(DLTR-US)最新財報顯示，對價格敏感的消費者愈來愈依賴「1美元商店」折扣商，尤其汽油價格上漲後，消費者減少長途購物、轉向住家附近採買，進一步推升折扣店客流。高收入家庭也持續光顧這類商店，購買非必需品。
兩家公司周四公布的上季營收都超越市場預期。其中，Dollar General上修全年銷售預測，並表示將在今年下半年恢復庫藏股計畫，帶動周四(27日)股價一度大漲約8%，終場仍漲2.5%。
Dollar General是全美最大1美元商店，擁有2.1萬家門市。該公司正在提高一般商品在商品組合中的占比，以因應收入較低消費者尋找更便宜的服飾、居家用品與玩具的趨勢。
Dollar General高層表示，汽油價格上漲迫使消費者減少出門購物的次數，並改在住家附近採買，有助於提升客流量。
Jefferies分析師Corey Tarlowe表示：「在汽油價格偏高的環境下，我們認為Dollar General是消費者愈來愈依賴的零售業態。」
同行Dollar Tree則出現四季以來首見的平均客流量增加。該公司目前正走出出售Family Dollar事業後的轉型期，加上對本季的獲利預估不如市場預期，周四終場下跌3.9%
值得注意的是，Dollar General與Dollar Tree高層均表示，燃料價格將在今年下半年拖累利潤率。
這兩家1美元折扣零售商的財報，凸顯美國經濟分化日益擴大：收入較低消費者轉向價格更實惠的商品，並延後非必要消費，而高收入家庭仍大手筆購買非必需品。
美國零售業指標企業沃爾瑪(WMT-US)上周罕見公布單季銷售不及市場預期，凸顯消費支出疲弱。另一方面，美國總統川普警告，隨著伊朗戰爭持續，燃料價格可能維持高檔。
Dollar Tree執行長Todd Vasos周四在分析師電話會議上表示：「最值得注意的是，燃料價格上漲且波動加劇，迫使消費者進一步將採購重點放在物有所值與價格實惠上。」
1美元商店如今也加入從沃爾瑪到目標百貨(Target)等零售商的行列，把部分關稅退款投入降價，針對食品雜貨及一般商品數千種商品調降價格，以藉此刺激消費。
Vasos表示，Dollar Tree在最近一季把收到的關稅退款中相當大一部分重新投入業務，以強化價格優勢，包括針對暑期假日推出促銷活動，以及降低日常商品價格。
paras_en: The U.S. consumer market is increasingly polarized. Dollar General (DG-US) and Dollar Tree (DLTR-US) latest earnings show that price‑sensitive shoppers are turning more to $1 discount stores, especially after gasoline prices rose, leading consumers to cut long trips and shop closer to home, further boosting foot traffic at discount retailers. High‑income households also continue to visit these stores to buy non‑essential items.

Both companies announced Q4 revenue that beat market expectations on Thursday. Dollar General raised its full‑year sales forecast and said it would resume its share‑repurchase program in the second half of the year, sending its stock up about 8% intraday before closing 2.5% higher.

Dollar General is the largest $1 store in the U.S., with 21,000 locations. The company is increasing the share of general merchandise in its assortment to meet the trend of lower‑income consumers seeking cheaper clothing, household goods, and toys.
Dollar General executives said that higher gasoline prices are forcing consumers to shop less frequently and to buy closer to home, which helps increase foot traffic.
Jefferies analyst Corey Tarlowe said, "In an environment of high gasoline prices, we believe Dollar General is a retail format that consumers are increasingly relying on."

Dollar Tree, a peer, saw its first seasonal increase in average foot traffic in four years. The company is emerging from the transition after selling its Family Dollar business, and with earnings guidance below expectations, its stock fell 3.9% on Thursday.
It is worth noting that executives at both Dollar General and Dollar Tree said fuel prices will drag on profit margins in the second half of the year.

The earnings of these two $1 discount retailers highlight the widening economic divide in the U.S.: lower‑income consumers turn to more affordable goods and postpone non‑essential spending, while high‑income households continue to make large purchases of non‑essentials.

Last week, retail indicator Walmart (WMT-US) unusually reported quarterly sales that fell short of expectations, underscoring weak consumer spending. Meanwhile, former President Trump warned that as the war in Iran continues, fuel prices may remain high.

Dollar Tree CEO Todd Vasos said on Thursday during an analyst call, "The most noteworthy thing is that fuel prices are rising and volatility is increasing, forcing consumers to focus even more on value and affordability."

$1 stores are now joining the ranks of retailers from Walmart to Target, allocating some of their tariff refunds to price cuts, reducing prices on thousands of grocery and general merchandise items to stimulate consumption.

Vasos said Dollar Tree recently reinvested a substantial portion of its tariff refunds back into the business to strengthen its price advantage, including promotional activities for the summer holidays and lowering everyday product prices.

items.title: 華許首秀過關！債市投下Fed主席最想要的信任票
items.title_en: Warsh’s First Test Passes! Bond Market Casts the Trust Vote Fed Chair Wants Most
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會釋出偏鷹訊號後，美國短期公債殖利率大幅上升，長期殖利率卻大致持穩。這種市場反應對新任央行主席而言，比債券上漲更重要，因為它代表投資人相信華許有意採取行動控制通膨。
華許週五表示，近期通膨仍令人擔憂，聯準會必須確認物價正明確且以足夠速度回到2%目標，否則還有工作要做。他也指出，除房市與農業等部分領域外，整體金融環境很難被形容為具有限制性，顯示目前利率尚未明顯壓抑經濟活動。
這番談話迅速改變市場定價。芝商所 FedWatch 工具顯示，交易員預估聯準會9月升息的機率，由本週稍早略高於30%升至接近60%。
根據FactSet數據，美國2年期公債殖利率週五上升12個基點至4.352%，創五週新高；30年期公債殖利率則大致持平於5.207%。兩者利差縮小至約87個基點，為近一個月最低。
殖利率曲線趨平反映出兩層市場預期：短期利率可能維持高檔甚至進一步上升，但較緊縮的政策最終可望抑制物價，因此長期通膨風險並未同步惡化。
Clocktower Group首席總體策略師Eric Wallerstein表示，經歷數次讓市場難以判讀新主席立場的聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 會議後，交易員需要看到聯準會對控制通膨的承諾。華許此次演說初步回應了這項需求。
長債賣壓並非主要來自通膨
不過，債市接受華許的抗通膨訊號，不代表近期美債面臨的所有壓力都已解除。長天期公債殖利率升至20年高點附近，主要受到財政與供給因素推動，而非單純反映物價前景。
美國政府債務已突破40兆美元，財政赤字約1.8兆美元，財政部因而必須發行數兆美元新債。科技業超大規模雲端業者也在大量發行長期公司債，為AI資料中心建設籌措資金，與美國政府競爭市場資本。
Wallerstein指出，長期借貸成本仍取決於經濟表現、財政前景及科技巨頭後續發債規模，這些因素多半不在聯準會控制範圍內。
9月升息仍要看數據
XTB研究主管Kathleen Brooks提醒，單次偏鷹演說不足以確立未來利率路徑。華許不支持透過前瞻指引預告政策，因此市場仍須依據後續經濟數據調整預期。
若下週公布的勞動市場報告再次疲弱，9月升息機率可能迅速下降，週五出現的短債賣壓也可能隨之消退。
縮表方向成為下一項考驗
華許此次並未說明如何處理規模約6.7兆至6.8兆美元的聯準會資產負債表。他正主導縮減央行資產規模的檢討，但任何進一步量化緊縮，都可能增加市場需要承接的美債供給。
Fidelis Capital固定收益主管Chris Gunster認為，這項政策與財政部降低長期利率的努力存在潛在矛盾。財長貝森特正透過債券回購計畫降低借貸成本；若聯準會同步減少美債持有部位，可能反而對長債殖利率形成上行壓力。
因此，華許這次通過的是「市場是否相信其抗通膨決心」的考驗；接下來，他還須面對經濟數據變化，以及如何在縮減資產負債表的同時，避免加重長債市場壓力。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh issued a hawkish signal at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Summit, U.S. short‑term Treasury yields surged while long‑term yields largely held steady. This market reaction is more important for the new chair than bond price moves, as it signals investors believe Warsh intends to act to control inflation.

Warsh said on Friday that inflation remains concerning and the Fed must confirm that prices are clearly and quickly returning to the 2% target, otherwise more work is needed. He also noted that, aside from housing and agriculture, the overall financial environment is difficult to describe as restrictive, indicating current rates have not yet noticeably stifled economic activity.
This speech quickly altered market pricing. The CME FedWatch tool shows traders’ probability of a September rate hike rose from just over 30% earlier this week to nearly 60%.

According to FactSet data, the U.S. 2‑year Treasury yield rose 12 basis points to 4.352% on Friday, a five‑week high; the 30‑year yield remained roughly flat at 5.207%. The spread narrowed to about 87 basis points, the lowest in nearly a month.

The flattening yield curve reflects two layers of market expectations: short‑term rates may stay high or rise further, but tighter policy is expected to curb inflation, so long‑term inflation risk has not worsened in tandem.

Eric Wallerstein, chief overall strategist at Clocktower Group, said that after several FOMC meetings that left markets uncertain about the new chair’s stance, traders needed to see the Fed’s commitment to controlling inflation. Warsh’s speech initially met that need.
Long‑bond selling pressure is not primarily driven by inflation

However, the bond market’s acceptance of Warsh’s anti‑inflation signal does not mean all recent pressures on U.S. Treasuries have been lifted. Long‑term Treasury yields have risen to near 20‑year highs, driven mainly by fiscal and supply factors rather than purely reflecting price outlooks.

U.S. government debt has surpassed $40 trillion, with a fiscal deficit of about $1.8 trillion, forcing the Treasury to issue several trillion dollars in new debt. Large cloud‑service tech firms are also issuing long‑term corporate bonds in bulk to fund AI data‑center construction, competing with the government for market capital.
Wallerstein noted that long‑term borrowing costs still depend on economic performance, fiscal outlook, and the scale of future tech‑giant bond issuances—factors largely outside the Fed’s control.
September rate hike still depends on data

Kathleen Brooks, head of research at XTB, warned that a single hawkish speech is insufficient to set the future rate path. Warsh does not support forward guidance, so markets must still adjust expectations based on subsequent economic data.
If the labor‑market report released next week remains weak, the probability of a September hike could drop sharply, and the short‑bond selling pressure seen on Friday might fade.
The direction of the balance‑sheet reduction becomes the next test

Warsh did not explain how he would handle the Fed’s balance sheet, which stands at about $6.7 to $6.8 trillion. He is leading a review of reducing the central bank’s asset size, but any further quantitative tightening could increase the supply of Treasuries the market must absorb.

Chris Gunster, fixed‑income head at Fidelis Capital, believes this policy may conflict with Treasury efforts to lower long‑term rates. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen is reducing borrowing costs through a bond‑repurchase program; if the Fed simultaneously cuts Treasury holdings, it could actually push long‑bond yields higher.

Thus, Warsh’s test this time is whether the market believes in his anti‑inflation resolve; next, he must face changing economic data and how to trim the balance sheet without adding pressure to the long‑bond market.

items.title: Cursor遭OpenAI「斷供」 SpaceX 600億美元收購後合作關係急轉彎
items.title_en: Cursor Cut Off by OpenAI After SpaceX’s $60 Billion Acquisition
paras: OpenAI週五(28日)宣布，計畫終止向Cursor提供AI模型的合作協議，理由是該公司無法確信SpaceX將按照OpenAI的服務條款使用相關技術。Cursor目前已成為馬斯克旗下SpaceX的一部分，此舉也使兩家AI陣營之間的競爭進一步升溫。
OpenAI表示，公司「並不確信SpaceX會在我們的服務條款範圍內」使用其技術，因此決定結束現有合作。不過，OpenAI並未進一步說明SpaceX究竟有哪些具體使用方式引發疑慮，也未透露協議終止的確切時間表。SpaceX截至報導時尚未回應相關詢問。
此次合作生變的時間點格外敏感。SpaceX在今年6月宣布以600億美元全股票交易收購Anysphere，也就是Cursor的母公司，交易預計在第三季完成。Cursor在8月14日正式宣布收購完成，並成為SpaceX旗下公司。
SpaceX最初在4月宣布與Cursor展開合作，雙方計畫共同開發新一代「coding and knowledge work AI」，同時SpaceX取得日後以600億美元收購Cursor的選擇權。SpaceX希望藉由Cursor的AI程式開發工具與工程人才，進一步強化自身AI布局。
Cursor是近年快速崛起的AI程式開發工具，核心產品可利用大型語言模型協助開發者撰寫、修改與測試程式碼。Cursor官方8月宣布，SpaceX收購已正式完成，這也意味著Cursor從原本可整合多家AI模型的獨立工具，轉變為SpaceX AI版圖的一部分。
這項所有權變化也讓Cursor與OpenAI之間原本的模型合作關係變得更加複雜。OpenAI如今決定終止協議，意味著Cursor未來可能需要調整模型供應來源，或更加依賴SpaceX自身的AI技術。
另一方面，SpaceX收購Cursor本身就是馬斯克擴大AI布局的重要一步。600億美元交易不僅是SpaceX有史以來最大規模的收購案之一，也使公司取得成熟的AI程式開發產品與相關人才，進一步向OpenAI及Anthropic等AI業者主導的開發工具市場發起挑戰。
Cursor在SpaceX旗下的定位也已開始發生變化。Cursor此前曾透過多種模型提供AI程式開發能力，而SpaceX收購後，外界開始關注它是否會逐步轉向與馬斯克旗下AI體系更深度整合，包括與Grok及SpaceX的AI運算資源結合。
此次OpenAI決定終止合作，也發生在AI產業對模型安全、使用規範及AI代理風險更加關注之際。路透社日前報導，今年稍早俄語系駭客曾利用Cursor入侵至少7家公司，駭客透過誘導AI代理執行惡意任務等方式，加速憑證竊取與漏洞利用。這起事件凸顯AI程式工具在安全與使用權限方面面臨的新風險。
包括OpenAI、微軟 (MSFT-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)及IBM (IBM-US)在內的逾100家科技與金融企業日前也共同呼籲政府與企業加強防範AI驅動的網路攻擊，並主張建立更嚴格的可信任AI模型存取機制。
對OpenAI而言，終止Cursor合作也反映出AI模型供應商與應用層業者之間的關係正在改變。過去AI應用公司可以同時整合OpenAI、Anthropic及Google等多家模型，但當應用工具被大型科技企業收購後，模型供應商與平台所有者之間可能從合作夥伴轉變為直接競爭者。
目前OpenAI尚未公布終止協議後的具體執行安排，SpaceX也尚未公開回應。隨著Cursor已正式納入SpaceX體系，這場模型供應關係的變化，可能成為OpenAI與馬斯克AI版圖競爭升溫的最新訊號。
paras_en: OpenAI announced on Friday (the 28th) that it plans to terminate its AI model partnership agreement with Cursor, citing uncertainty that SpaceX will use the technology in accordance with OpenAI’s service terms. Cursor is now part of Elon Musk’s SpaceX, and the move further heats the rivalry between the two AI camps.

OpenAI said it “is not confident SpaceX will use its technology within the scope of our service terms,” so it has decided to end the existing collaboration. The company did not detail which specific uses by SpaceX raised concerns, nor did it disclose a timeline for the termination. SpaceX had not responded to inquiries at the time of reporting.

The timing of the partnership shift is especially sensitive. In June, SpaceX announced a $60 billion all‑stock deal to acquire Anysphere, the parent company of Cursor, with the transaction expected to close in Q3. Cursor officially announced the completion of the acquisition on August 14, becoming a SpaceX subsidiary.

SpaceX first announced a collaboration with Cursor in April, planning to co‑develop a new generation of “coding and knowledge‑work AI,” while also securing an option to acquire Cursor for $60 billion later. SpaceX hopes to leverage Cursor’s AI coding tools and engineering talent to strengthen its own AI strategy.

Cursor has rapidly risen as an AI coding‑assistant tool, with its core product using large language models to help developers write, modify and test code. In August, Cursor confirmed that SpaceX’s acquisition was finalized, turning the once‑independent tool that could integrate multiple AI models into part of SpaceX’s AI portfolio.

This ownership change also complicates the original model‑supply relationship between Cursor and OpenAI. By ending the agreement, OpenAI signals that Cursor may need to source models elsewhere or rely more heavily on SpaceX’s own AI technology going forward.

Meanwhile, the SpaceX purchase of Cursor is a key step for Musk to expand his AI footprint. The $60 billion deal is one of SpaceX’s largest acquisitions ever, giving the company a mature AI coding product and talent pool, and positioning it to challenge AI tool markets dominated by OpenAI, Anthropic and others.

Cursor’s role within SpaceX is already shifting. Previously, Cursor offered AI coding capabilities through a variety of models; after the acquisition, observers are watching whether it will gradually integrate more deeply with Musk’s AI ecosystem, including Grok and SpaceX’s AI compute resources.

OpenAI’s decision to end the partnership comes as the AI industry focuses more on model safety, usage guidelines and AI‑agent risks. Reuters recently reported that earlier this year Russian‑language hackers used Cursor to breach at least seven companies, prompting AI agents to perform malicious tasks that accelerated credential theft and exploit chaining, highlighting new security and permission risks for AI coding tools.

Over 100 technology and financial firms—including OpenAI, Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US) and IBM (IBM‑US)—have jointly urged governments and enterprises to strengthen defenses against AI‑driven cyber attacks and to establish stricter trusted‑AI model access mechanisms.

For OpenAI, ending the Cursor partnership reflects a shifting dynamic between AI model providers and application‑layer companies. Historically, AI application firms could integrate models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others, but when such tools are bought by large tech conglomerates, model providers and platform owners may move from partners to direct competitors.

OpenAI has not yet disclosed the concrete implementation plan after terminating the agreement, and SpaceX has not publicly responded. With Cursor now officially part of SpaceX, this change in model‑supply relations could be the latest signal of an intensifying competition between OpenAI and Musk’s AI empire.

items.title: 古爾斯比力挺華許抗通膨！警告經濟過熱 通膨尚未脫離險境
items.title_en: Goolsbee Backs Warsh’s Anti‑Inflation Stance, Warns Economy Is Overheating and Inflation Still in Danger
paras: 芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)周五(28日)表示，他認同聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)主張應把抗通膨列為首要任務的看法。
古爾斯比受訪說：「我同意主席提出的分析，我們的通膨率一直高於目標，而且此前走勢朝錯誤方向發展。雖然近幾個月的數據較為溫和，但這絕對不代表我們已經脫離險境。
華許周五在懷俄明州傑克森霍爾的全球央行年會演說時表示，儘管今年夏季公布的個人消費支出物價指數 (PCE) 與消費者物價指數 (CPI) 優於預期，但這些數據仍不足以證明潛在通膨趨勢已出現有意義的改善。
華許強調，Fed 必須確信潛在通膨正「明確且以足夠速度」朝 2% 目標前進，否則 Fed 仍「有工作要做。」他還提到，目前金融環境並不具有限制性，利率仍是 Fed 實現政策使命的「主要工具」。
雖然華許並未直接表態支持9月升息，但市場將這番談話解讀為明顯偏鷹。芝商所(CME)FedWatch 顯示，交易員押注Fed 9月升息1碼的機率，在演說後突破五成，遠高於前一日的約 35%。短債殖利率在演說後迅速跳升，2年期美債殖利率大漲約12個基點至4.35%。
目前美國通膨依然居高不下，與Fed 2%目標相比甚至比一年前更遙遠。經濟過熱的跡象隨處可見——勞動市場罕見呈現招募與裁員活動都維持低檔，美國經濟雖持續成長，但主要動能來自人工智慧(AI)以及資料中心建設。
古爾斯比補充指出，Fed官員目前正面臨一個問題：近期通膨升高的趨勢究竟只是暫時現象，還是會因經濟過熱而演變成更頑強的通膨。他擔心的是，Fed決策官員對於該如何讓經濟降溫，仍存在高度不確定性。他表示，下一波衝擊可能隨時就在眼前。
paras_en: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said on Friday the 28th that he agrees with Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s view that fighting inflation should be the top priority.

In the interview Goolsbee said, “I agree with the Chair’s analysis – our inflation rate has been above target and the trend has been moving in the wrong direction. Although the data in recent months have been more moderate, that certainly does not mean we are out of danger.”

Warsh told the Global Central Bank Conference in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, that even though this summer’s personal consumption expenditures price index (PCE) and consumer price index (CPI) came in better than expected, the numbers are still insufficient to show a meaningful improvement in underlying inflation trends.

Warsh stressed that the Fed must be convinced that underlying inflation is moving “clearly and at a sufficient pace” toward the 2% goal, otherwise the Fed still “has work to do.” He also noted that the current financial environment is not restrictive and that interest rates remain the Fed’s “primary tool” for achieving its policy mission.

Although Warsh did not explicitly endorse a September rate hike, markets read his remarks as clearly hawkish. CME FedWatch showed that after the speech traders’ odds of a one‑point hike in September jumped above 50%, up from roughly 35% the day before. Short‑term Treasury yields surged, with the two‑year yield climbing about 12 basis points to 4.35% after the remarks.

U.S. inflation remains high, even farther from the Fed’s 2% target than a year ago. Signs of an overheating economy are everywhere – the labor market is unusually tight with both hiring and layoffs at low levels, and while the U.S. economy continues to grow, its main drivers are AI and data‑center construction.

Goolsbee added that Fed officials now face a key question: whether the recent uptick in inflation is a temporary blip or a sign that overheating will turn into more stubborn inflation. He warned that policymakers are still highly uncertain about how to cool the economy and said the next shock could be right around the corner.

items.title: 美海軍被曝陷入嚴重財政危機！傳靠挪用軍人「薪水」打伊朗
paras: 美國對伊朗的軍事行動持續延燒，軍費壓力也逐步浮現。《衛報》報導指出，美國海軍因承擔對伊朗軍事行動及海上封鎖任務，現有預算面臨嚴重壓力，甚至被迫調度原本用於支付軍人薪資的資金。
報導指出，美國總統川普自2月28日發動對伊朗軍事行動後，美軍預算壓力明顯升高，其中海軍除了參與最初幾輪攻擊，後續也負責執行海上封鎖。
一份美國國防部有關海軍經費的備忘錄顯示，國防部為支應軍事行動，調用了原本配置在薪資帳戶中的資金，導致資金短缺。
一名知情軍官表示，軍方目前只能透過不同帳戶之間調度資金來填補缺口，甚至出現原本準備支付薪資的款項遭挪用，再以其他尚未動用的資金補回的情況。
美國海軍2026財政年度預算接近3000億美元，但受到法律規範限制，無法自由重新分配各項預算。
川普政府本財政年度提出670億美元的緊急追加撥款申請，其中約150億美元預計用於採購「愛國者」飛彈、「薩德」反導系統及多款飛彈，但相關申請並未說明其中有多少資金將投入海軍。
美國眾議院7月已通過總額1.15兆美元的2027財政年度國防授權法案，另有730億美元專門作為伊朗戰事相關額外支出。
不過，《衛報》認為，由於美國國內對伊朗戰事普遍缺乏支持，這兩項預算案能否獲得參議院批准仍存在疑問。
對於外界關注軍費是否已經見底，美國海軍發言人在聲明中表示，目前維持及作戰經費「尚未耗盡」，海軍部正積極調配資源，以確保能夠按時履行現有薪資支付義務。
然而，報導指出，海軍內部的資金吃緊早已不是秘密。隨著戰事持續，如何為一場沒有明確終點的軍事行動取得足夠資金，已成為更大的問題。在資金壓力下，美國海軍部分岸上設施的非緊急維護工作已經暫停。
一名前海軍軍官、目前擔任海軍承包商的知情人士更形容，美軍不僅消耗大量軍事彈藥，也已面臨資金耗盡的困境。

伊朗海上封鎖持續　美軍投入逾20艘軍艦

美軍對伊朗的海上封鎖自7月中旬恢復後，伊朗從本國港口出口的石油降至零，未獲美方許可的船隻也無法進出伊朗港口，目前僅因人道主義理由的船隻獲准通行。
美國中央司令部司令庫珀（Brad Cooper）上將8月27日表示，自封鎖恢復以來，美軍已投入超過20艘軍艦及數百架軍機，迫使75艘企圖突破封鎖的船隻掉頭，另有3艘拒絕服從指令的船隻被迫失去行動能力。目前約有5萬名美軍人員在中東執行相關任務。
與此同時，美軍航母部署也面臨壓力。近日「華盛頓號」（USS George Washington）才接替已在海上部署超過200天的「林肯號」（USS Abraham Lincoln），但美軍很快又計畫派遣「羅斯福號」（USS Theodore Roosevelt）接替「華盛頓號」。
中國現代國際關係研究院中東所副所長秦天分析，美軍希望維持在中東地區的軍事壓力，因此持續調派航母。但隨著「華盛頓號」抵達中東，美軍在亞太地區出現多年罕見的「零航母」狀態，反映美軍在中東乃至全球兵力部署上面臨的困境。
針對近期美軍航母接連傳出長時間部署及艦上人員心理危機等消息，秦天指出，美軍此次與伊朗的戰事高度依賴航母，原因之一在於伊朗曾以飛彈及無人機攻擊美軍部署在海灣地區的前線基地，使這些基地難以充分分擔作戰任務，也無法完全為航母提供安全靠泊與補給服務。

白宮稱美伊目前沒有談判　川普：不急著讓伊朗回談判桌

外交層面上，美伊目前也未出現新的談判進展。白宮新聞秘書萊維特（Karoline Leavitt）27日表示，美國與伊朗目前「沒有進行任何談判」，這種情況將持續到川普認為伊朗可能以有意義的方式重返談判桌為止。
萊維特表示，美國仍將透過各種經濟手段持續對伊朗施壓，川普「仍保留所有選項」，而他的首要目標是確保伊朗永遠無法取得核武器。
川普26日接受卡達半島電視台訪問時則表示，他對伊朗何時重返談判桌「沒有時間表」，也不急於推動談判。他稱美國正在取得重大勝利，並指出伊朗正面臨嚴重通膨與經濟崩潰；當被問及經濟制裁是否比軍事打擊更有效時，川普回答兩者都有效。
不過，伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚（Masoud Pezeshkian）同日透過伊朗學生通訊社表示，伊朗政府已採取相關措施，因此美國目前的經濟施壓不會取得成果，就如同美方在戰事中同樣未能達成目標。

items.title: 「巴菲特式投資」可能淪為AI時代受害者？
items.title_en: Will Buffett‑Style Investing Become a Victim of the AI Era?
paras: 「巴菲特式投資」可能成為 AI 時代的受害者。科技分析師兼播客主持人 Dwarkesh Patel 警告，當全球資本加速流向 AI 基礎設施，依靠長期穩定現金流支撐估值的波克夏·海瑟威式股票，恐面臨大幅重新定價。
Patel 所指的「巴菲特式股票」，是投資人願意長期持有、預期未來數十年持續創造良好現金流的企業。然而，隨著 OpenAI、Anthropic 等前沿 AI 實驗室快速擴充運算能力，資金正大量湧向資料中心、半導體、能源和機器人等領域，傳統企業的吸引力可能隨之下降。
這波投資潮也將讓微軟 (MSFT-US)、Alphabet (GOOG-US)、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 和 Meta (META-US) 等超大規模雲端業者吸收更多資本。Patel 認為，當 AI 基礎設施展現更高的潛在報酬，投資人將要求傳統企業提供更高收益，才願意繼續投入資金。
真正威脅巴菲特式股票的關鍵，在於折現率上升。利率及投資人要求的報酬率一旦走高，企業未來現金流換算成當前價值後便會下降，導致原本以穩定獲利為賣點的企業估值受到壓縮。
Patel 直言，市場可能因此形成兩極化走勢。AI 類股大漲或許足以支撐整體指數，但幾乎所有其他股票都可能下跌，尤其是那些以未來 30 年穩定現金流作為估值基礎的「巴菲特、波克夏類型股票」。
這種資本轉移的衝擊也可能擴散至債券市場。Patel 警告，資金成本急升可能形成類似「第二次伏克爾衝擊」的局面，增加開發中國家爆發主權債務違約的風險。
他舉例，若美國投資級超大規模雲端業者的債券可以提供約 10%報酬，投資人便不願再以僅約 5%的利率借錢給埃及等風險較高的國家。這將迫使財政脆弱的國家及傳統產業支付更高的融資成本，否則可能面臨違約。
Patel 認為，AI 快速成長長期而言可能創造更富足的經濟，但在資本全面轉向新科技的過渡期，巴菲特所偏好的穩定現金流資產，反而可能因資金機會成本飆升而承受沉重賣壓。
paras_en: Buffett‑style investing may become a victim of the AI era. Technology analyst and podcast host Dwarkesh Patel warns that as global capital accelerates toward AI infrastructure, stocks that rely on long‑term stable cash flows to support valuation—like Berkshire Hathaway‑style equities—may face significant re‑pricing.

Patel’s “Buffett‑style stocks” are companies investors are willing to hold long term, expecting to generate strong cash flows for decades. However, as cutting‑edge AI labs such as OpenAI and Anthropic rapidly expand computing power, capital is pouring into data centers, semiconductors, energy and robotics, potentially eroding the appeal of traditional firms.

This investment wave will also allow mega‑cloud players such as Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOG‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Meta (META‑US) to absorb more capital. Patel believes that when AI infrastructure shows higher potential returns, investors will demand higher yields from traditional companies before they are willing to keep investing.

The real threat to Buffett‑style stocks lies in rising discount rates. When interest rates and required returns climb, the present value of a company’s future cash flows falls, compressing the valuation of firms that previously sold themselves on stable profitability.

Patel bluntly states that the market may polarize. AI‑related stocks could surge enough to support the overall index, while almost all other stocks—especially those that base valuation on 30‑year stable cash flows—might decline.

The capital shift could also spill over into the bond market. Patel warns that a sharp rise in funding costs could create a situation akin to a “second Volcker shock,” increasing the risk of sovereign debt defaults in developing countries.

He gives an example: if U.S. investment‑grade mega‑cloud issuers can offer about 10% returns, investors will no longer lend at roughly 5% to higher‑risk countries like Egypt. This would force fiscally fragile nations and traditional industries to pay higher financing costs or face default.

Patel believes that while AI’s rapid growth may create a richer economy in the long run, during the transition when capital fully shifts to new technology, the stable‑cash‑flow assets favored by Buffett may suffer heavy selling pressure as the opportunity cost of capital soars.

items.title: Teradyne再告中國協作機器人廠專利戰從軟體延伸至硬體
items.title_en: Teradyne Extends Patent Battle Against Chinese Collaborative Robot Manufacturer from Software to Hardware
paras: 2026年08月29日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球協作機器人市場競爭升溫，技術專利開始成為新的競爭門檻。Teradyne(TER-US)旗下Teradyne Robotics已對中國協作機器人廠節卡機器人(JAKA)德國子公司提起專利侵權訴訟，指控其多款協作機器人涉及侵犯Universal Robots的硬體及軟體專利。
這已是Teradyne Robotics今年第2度在歐洲對中國機器人業者採取法律行動。2026年2月，公司曾控告中國協作機器人廠艾利特機器人(Elite Robots)德國子公司侵犯軟體著作權，德國漢堡地方法院4月已發布初步禁制令，禁止相關爭議軟體及產品在德國銷售，目前案件仍在進行。

專利戰升級判決影響可能擴及歐洲多國
JAKA目前產品包括雙臂人形機器人K1、重載K1-25、輪式機器人Kargo及Lumi實體AI智慧平台等。其中Kargo已導入世界500強企業工廠，用於分揀與搬運；JAKA S系列協作機器人也取得IEC 60601醫療電氣設備安全認證，為切入醫療自動化市場建立基礎。
相較Elite Robots案件主要涉及軟體著作權，此次JAKA訴訟涵蓋多項專利，範圍同時涉及機器人的硬體及軟體設計。Universal Robots表示，公司購入JAKA產品拆解研究後，認為其中可能存在專利侵權。
案件已向歐洲統一專利法院(UPC)哥本哈根地方分庭提出。若Teradyne勝訴，影響可能不只限於德國或丹麥，而是擴大至多個歐洲市場，增加JAKA相關產品在當地銷售的不確定性。
Teradyne強調，訴訟並非針對中國企業，而是保護公司投入大量研發資源建立的智慧財產權。隨著中國協作機器人業者加速進軍歐洲，市場競爭正從價格、負載能力與產品性能，進一步延伸至專利、軟體及智慧財產權。
